original: athārthakakriyāśabdena nodakāharaṇādikamucyate kintu jñānameva sukhātmakaṃ sarvacca sukhajñānaṃ svātmani svata eva pramāṇamavyabhicāradityucyate tathā sati bhavatu nāmārthakriyāniścayaḥ tathāpi  tu na tayā                      pūrvajñānasya śakyaṃ yāthārthyaṃ vijñātum| ayathārthādapi svapne candanalepādinā sukhotpateḥ|

original: api ca gṛhītāvinābhāvayā'rthakriyayā pūrvajñānaviṣayasya niścayaḥ anumānaṃ hyaetatkāryātkāraṇagocaram, na cāgṛhīte sambandhini sambandhagrahaṇasambhavaḥ| tena sambandhagrahaṇasamaye'vaśyaṃ ghaṭajñānādeva ghaṭaniścayo'ṅgikartavyaḥ| evaṃ guṇajñānasaṃvādajñānayorapi vācyam|

original: na hi guṇājñānādguṇo'pi niścetuṃ śakyate kiṃ punaḥ pūrvajñānaprāmāṇyam tathā saṃvādo'pi| saṃvādo nāma pūrvajñānāniścitamanena niścīyate| yadyapi vastutvājjanyo niścayaḥ tathāpi jñānenaiva janyate nānyena| tasmātsvata eva prāmāṇyaṃ parataścāprāmāṇyaṃ doṣajñānadbādhakajñānādvā niśceyam|

original: yadyevaṃ tato yadeva kiñcidrāgadveṣalobhādiṅrinartharūpamarthatayoddhiśya puruṣaḥ pravartate| tatsarvaṃ kāryaṃ

original: sā ca paścādanarthatvāvagame'pi na bādhyate| na khalu jānnapyanarthamuddiśya na me pravṛtiḥ saṃjātetyadhyavasyati kintvanarthamevoddiśya mohātpravṛto'smītyavagaccchati| tasmātpratyakṣapramāṇikā yeyaṃ kṛtyuddeśyatvamātrarūpā kāryatā na tadavagatiḥ pravṛtikāraṇamiti siddhama|

analyzed: tad adhīne tu niyame paraspara āśraya doṣa āpateḥ svābhāvika tvāt avyabhicāraḥ iti ced na svābhāvika tve eva pramāṇa abhāvāt anaupādhika tvam eva svābhāvika tvam na ca upādhi anavagati mātreṇa tad abhāva siddhiḥ iti uktam api ca svābhāvikam na vyabhicarati iti atra kim pramāṇam na tāvat pratyakṣam na anumānam na anyat kiñcid

original: dṛṣṭaścānaupādhikasyāpi kālasaṃbandhasya vyabhicārastathā'gnisambandhasyāpi syāt| api cānyayorevāgnidhūmayordaṣṭāntadharmiṇi sambandho'vagataḥ anyaścāyaṃ parvatavartī dhūmaḥ
analyzed: dṛṣṭaḥ ca anaupādhikasya api kāla saṃbandhasya vyabhicāraḥ tathā agni sambandhasya api syāt api ca anyayoḥ eva agni dhūmayoḥ daṣṭānta dharmiṇi sambandhaḥ uvagataḥ anyaḥ ca ayam parvata vartī dhūmaḥ

original: tasyāgnisambandho'navagata iti kathaṃ liṅgaṃ syāt| atha sāmānyaṃ liṅgaṃ na tasya saṃbandhānavagamāt| deśakālābhyāṃ sambandhena jātyā ca sarvaiḥ dravyameva viśeṣyate na tu sambandhasya jāteśca parasparānvayaḥ jāterapi  saṃyogavaddravyaviśeṣaṇatvāt|
analyzed: tasya agni sambandhaḥ ūna avagataḥ iti katham liṅgam syāt atha sāmānyam liṅgam na tasya saṃbandha anavagamāt deśa kālābhyām sambandhena jātyā ca sarvaiḥ dravyam eva viśeṣyate na tu sambandhasya jāteḥ ca paraspara anvayaḥ jāteḥ api saṃyogavat dravya viśeṣaṇa tvāt

original: atha dravyadvāreṇāsti jātyorapi sambandhaḥ tathā'pyādrendhanādyaupadhirivāgnerdhūmasbandhastadabhāve kālāntare taddravyābhāve tadvārakaḥ sambandho'pi na syāt| dravyāntaradvārastu kālāntarasambandhaḥ prāganavagata ita kathamanumānāṅgam| na ca viśeṣaparihāreṇa sāmānyayoḥ sakṛddarśanena śakyāvagamaḥ sambandhaḥ|
analyzed: atha dravya dvāreṇa asti jātyoḥ api sambandhaḥ tathā api ādra indhana ādi aupadhiḥ iva agneḥ dhūma sbandhaḥ tad abhāve kāla antare tad dravya abhāve tad vārakaḥ sambandhaḥ api na syāt dravya antara dvāraḥ tu kāla antara sambandhaḥ prāk anavagataḥ ita katham anumāna aṅgam na ca viśeṣa parihāreṇa sāmānyayoḥ sakṛt darśanena śakya avagamaḥ sambandhaḥ

original: kiñca deśakālābhyāmapi dravyadvāreṇa saṃyogasyāpyavaccheda iti nānavaccchinnatvam| yathā ca jātyodravyadvārakaḥ sambandhaḥ svābhāviko bhavatyevamagnisambandhasya tatkālāvacchedo dravyadvārako'pi svābhāvikaḥ syāditi tatkālaprahāṇena na kālāntare sambandhastiṣṭhedityasambandha eva kālāntare'gnidhūmayorbhavaduktayā nītyā niścetavyaḥ syāt na tu
analyzed: kiñca deśa kālābhyām api dravya dvāreṇa saṃyogasya api avacchedaḥ iti na anavacchinna tvam yathā ca jātyoḥ dravya dvārakaḥ sambandhaḥ svābhāvikaḥ bhavati evam agni sambandhasya tad kāla avacchedaḥ dravya dvārakaḥ api svābhāvikaḥ syāt iti tad kāla prahāṇena na kāla antare sambandhaḥ tiṣṭhet iti asambandhaḥ eva kāla antare agni dhūmayoḥ bhavat uktayā nītyā niścetavyaḥ syāt na tu

original: kālāntare'gnisambandhaśaṅkā'pi dhūmasya syādityalamatinirbandhena| aparaṃ matam śataśo'gnau dhūmadarśanādanagnau cādarśanānniyato'yamagnineti pratītistāvadupajāyate tiraścāmapi| na ceyamapramāṇaṃ sarvadā sarveṣāṃ  saṃvāditvena jāyamānatvāt| ataḥ pramāṇamevedam| tacca ṣaḍvidhāntarbhūtam|
analyzed: kāla antare agni sambandha śaṅkā api dhūmasya syāt iti alam ati nirbandhena aparam matam śataśas ugnau dhūma darśanāt anagnau ca adarśanāt niyataḥ yam agninā iti pratītiḥ tāvat upajāyate tiraścām api na ca iyam apramāṇam sarvadā sarveṣām saṃvādi tvena jāyamāna tvāt atas pramāṇam eva idam tat ca ṣaḍvidha antarbhūtam

original: tatra nedamanumānaṃ sambhavati tasya niyamāvadhāraṇādhīnatvāt| na ca śābdamaśbadajanyatvāt| nopamānamasādṛśyaviṣayatvāt| nārthāpatirniyamamamantareṇānavakalpamānasya kasya cidadarśanāt| abhāvastu bhāvarūpe niyame dūrāpāsta eva|
analyzed: tatra na idam anumānam sambhavati tasya niyama avadhāraṇa adhīna tvāt na ca śābdam aśbat ajanya tvāt na upamānam asādṛśya viṣaya tvāt na arthāpatiḥ niyamam am antareṇa anavakalpamānasya kasya cit adarśanāt abhāvaḥ tu bhāva rūpe niyame dūra apāstaḥ eva

original: nanvayaṃ vipakṣavyāvṛtirūpo'bhāva eva na vyāvṛtimātraṃ niyamaḥ śaśaviṣāṇādeḥ sarvavipakṣavyāvṛtasya sarvārthaniyamaprasaṅgāt| vyāvṛtarapi sarvavipakṣebhyo durlabhaiva dṛśyādarśanābhāvāt| pāriśeṣyātpratyakṣamevedam| na ca prathamadarśane'navagamādapratyakṣam| ratnatatvasyeva bhūyaḥ paricayasacivapratyakṣaviṣayatvopapateḥ|
analyzed: nanu ayam vipakṣa vyāvṛti rūpaḥ bhāvaḥ eva na vyāvṛti mātram niyamaḥ śaśaviṣāṇa ādeḥ sarva vipakṣa vyāvṛtasya sarva artha niyama prasaṅgāt vyāvṛtaḥ api sarva vipakṣebhyaḥ durlabhā eva dṛśya adarśana abhāvāt pāriśeṣyāt pratyakṣam eva idam na ca prathama darśanena avagamāt apratyakṣam ratna tatvasya iva bhūyas paricaya saciva pratyakṣa viṣaya tva upapateḥ

original: nanu vartamānaviṣayaṃ pratyakṣaṃ tatkathamanena deśakālāntarasaṃbandhātmā niyamaḥ śkayāvagamaḥ| ucyate na kālāntarādisambandho niyamaḥ kintu svarūpaṃ dhūmādīnām| tacca vartamānamiti yuktaṃ pratyakṣagrāhyatvam| na hi niyamaṃ grahītuṃ deśāntarādisambandho grahītavyaḥ kuḍaḷadīnāmiva sthiraṃ rūpam|
analyzed: nanu vartamāna viṣayam pratyakṣam tat katham anena deśa kāla antara saṃbandha ātmā niyamaḥ ucyate na kāla antara ādi sambandhaḥ niyamaḥ kintu svarūpam dhūma ādīnām tat ca vartamānam iti yuktam pratyakṣa grāhya tvam na hi niyamam grahītum deśa antara ādi sambandhaḥ grahītavyaḥ kuḍaḷa dīnām iva sthiram rūpam

original: na hi teṣāṃ kālāntarasaṃbandho'pratyakṣa iti tadrapamapratyakṣaṃ bhavati| tathā sati nedaṃ rajatamiti pūrvajñānabādhakatvamutarakāle na syāt viṣayabhedāt| pūrvakāle hi rajatajñānena rajataṃ prasañjitam| utarakāle ca tadabāva iti viṣayabhedāt kathaṃ bādhakatvam| ataḥ sthirameva rajataṃ gṛhītamiti vaktavyam āha ca
analyzed: na hi teṣām kāla antara saṃbandhaḥ upratyakṣaḥ iti tad rapam apratyakṣam bhavati tathā sati na idam rajatam iti pūrva jñāna bādhaka tvam utara kāle na syāt viṣaya bhedāt pūrva kāle hi rajata jñānena rajatam prasañjitam utara kāle ca tad abāvaḥ iti viṣaya bhedāt katham bādhaka tvam atas sthiram eva rajatam gṛhītam iti vaktavyam āha ca

original: rajataṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ hi cirasthāyīti gamyate iti|
analyzed: rajatam gṛhyamāṇam hi cira sthāyi iti gamyate iti

original: tadvanniyamarūpaṃ gṛhyataiti yuktaṃ pratyakṣatvam| kīdṛśaṃ punaridaṃ rūpaṃ dhūmādīnāṃ niyato'yamagnineti niyamaḥ yadā yatra dhūmastadā tatrāgnirityarthaḥ| tasmādupapannaṃ pratyakṣaviṣayo niyama iti| tatredaṃ vaktavyam| kiṃ pratyakṣaṃ sarvaṃ vidyamānopalambhanam āho svidavidyamānopalambhamapīti|
analyzed: tadvat niyama rūpam gṛhyate eti yuktam pratyakṣa tvam kīdṛśam punar idam rūpam dhūma ādīnām niyataḥ uyam agninā iti niyamaḥ yadā yatra dhūmaḥ tadā tatra agniḥ iti arthaḥ tasmāt upapannam pratyakṣa viṣayaḥ niyamaḥ iti tatra idam vaktavyam kim pratyakṣam sarvam vidyamāna upalambhanam āho svid avidyamāna upalambham api iti

original: na tāvadavidyamānopalambhanaṃ pratyakṣaṃ nāma saṃbhavati| tatsaṃprayogajanitatven vidyamānopalambhanatvasya sthatatvāt| tathā ca niyamaviṣayatvāsambhavaḥ| tasya sarvadeśakālavyāpirūpatvāt| ayameva hi dhūmasyāgninā niyamaḥ yadākhiladhūmadeśakālavyāpitvamagneḥ| yathoktam||
analyzed: na tāvat avidyamāna upalambhanam pratyakṣam nāma saṃbhavati tad saṃprayoga janita tven vidyamāna upalambhana tvasya tathā ca niyama viṣaya tva asambhavaḥ tasya sarva deśa kāla vyāpi rūpa tvāt ayam eva hi dhūmasya agninā niyamaḥ yadā akhila dhūma deśa kāla vyāpi tvam agneḥ yathā uktam

original: yo yasya deśakālābhyāṃ samonyūno'pi vā bhavet|
analyzed: yaḥ yasya deśa kālābhyām vā bhavet

original: sa vyāpyo vyāpakastasay samo vā'pyadhiko'pi veti||
analyzed: sa vyāpyaḥ vyāpakaḥ tasay samaḥ vā api adhikaḥ api vā iti

original: yatu dhūsvarūpaniyama ityuktam astvetat svarūpamapi tadagnisambandhāvyabhicārātmakameva| kaścāsāvavyabhicāraḥ anyadato yāvadadhūmadeśakālamaganisambandhasaṃbhavāt| tathā ca tasmin pratyakṣīkriyamāṇe deśāntarādisaṃbandhaḥ pratyakṣa āpadyeta| tatsambandhātiriktantu pāṇḍuratvādivaddhūmagataṃ niyamābhidhānamaparokṣaṃ rūpamīkṣataiti  saṃvidvirūddham|
analyzed: yatu dhū svarūpa niyamaḥ iti uktam astu etat sva rūpam api tad agni sambandha avyabhicāra ātmakam eva kaḥ ca asau avyabhicāraḥ anyat atas yāvat adhūma deśa kālam agani sambandha saṃbhavāt tathā ca tasmin pratyakṣīkriyamāṇe deśa antara ādi saṃbandhaḥ pratyakṣaḥ āpadyeta tad sambandha atiriktam tu pāṇḍura tva ādi vat dhūma gatam niyama abhidhānam aparokṣam rūpam īkṣata eti saṃvid virūddham

original: yadi cedaṃ rūpāntaraṃ
analyzed: yadi ca idam rūpa antaram

original: pāṇḍuratvādivatsaṃbandhātiriktaṃ syāt tasmin pratyakṣagṛhīte'pi sarvadhūmadeśakālavyāpitvamagnergṛhītaṃ na syāt| na hyanyasmin gṛhīte'nyadgṛhītaṃ bhavati ati prasaṅgāt| agṛhīte ca deśakālāvyabhicāre kathamanumānodayaḥ| kiñcedaṃ rūpāntaramapi pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyamāṇaṃ sannihitadeśakālāvaccchinnameva gṛhyataiti na kālāntareṇa niyamaḥ sidhyet|
analyzed: pāṇḍura tva ādi vat saṃbandha atiriktam syāt tasmin pratyakṣa gṛhīte api sarva dhūma deśa kāla vyāpi tvam agneḥ gṛhītam na syāt na hi anyasmin gṛhīte nyat gṛhītam bhavati ati prasaṅgāt agṛhīte ca deśa kāla avyabhicāre katham anumāna udayaḥ kiñca idam rūpa antaram api pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyamāṇam sannihita deśa kāla avacchinnam eva gṛhyate eti na kāla antareṇa niyamaḥ sidhyet

original: yadapi darśitam kuḍaḷadīnāmiva sthitaṃ rūpamiti tadapi nirūpaṇīyam| kintatra sthāyitvameva gṛhyataityacchabhiprāyaḥ kiṃ vā yadvastutaḥ sthāsnuhyataiti kiṃ vā sthitiyogyatā| na tāvatpūrvaḥ kalpaḥ sthāyitā hyanekakālāvasthānaṃ sā kathaṃ pratyakṣaṇaiva gṛhyaeta tasya vartamānaviṣayatvāt|
analyzed: yat api darśitam kuḍaḷa dīnām iva sthitam rūpam iti tat api nirūpaṇīyam kim tatra sthāyi tvam eva gṛhyate eti accha abhiprāyaḥ kim vā yat vastutas kim vā sthiti yogyatā na tāvat pūrvaḥ kalpaḥ sthāyi tā hi aneka kāla avasthānam sā katham pratyakṣaṇā eva tasya vartamāna viṣaya tvāt

original: yadi cedaṃ pratyakṣeṇaiva gṛhyate tataḥ sthāyitāprasiddhye pratyakṣabhijñādaro nirarthakaḥ syāt| dvitīye tu kalpe kuḍaḷrūpameva tat nānyat evamihāpi yadvastuto niyataṃ dhūmasvarūpameva tatpratyakṣamityeva siddhyet| na ca tāvatā kiṃ citprayojanamasti yogyatā tu sarvabhāvānāmarthāpatigamyeti pratyakṣagamyatā'nupapatiḥ|
analyzed: yadi ca idam pratyakṣeṇa eva gṛhyate tatas sthāyi tā prasiddhye pratyakṣa abhijñā ādaraḥ nirarthakaḥ syāt dvitīye tu kalpe kuḍaḷ rūpam eva tat na anyat evam iha api yat vastutas niyatam dhūma svarūpam eva tat pratyakṣam iti eva siddhyet na ca tāvatā kim cit prayojanam asti yogyatā tu sarva bhāvānām arthāpati gamyā iti pratyakṣa gamya tā anupapatiḥ

original: sa tādṛśāṃ sthāyutvasya pūrvamevānugamādānumānikaḥ| spaṣṭaṃ cāsyānumānikatvamuktarūpatvāt| tathā hi īdṛśīyamavagatiḥ yadi śastrādinā naitadbhidyate tataḥ kiyantaṃ cit kālaṃ sthāsyatīti| evaṃ rajatādiṣvapyānumānikameva tadrūpasya sthāyitvam| anenaivābhiprāyeṇoktam|
analyzed: sa tādṛśām sthāyu tvasya pūrvam eva anugamāt ānumānikaḥ spaṣṭam ca asya ānumānika tvam ukta rūpatvāt tathā hi īdṛśī iyam avagatiḥ yadi śastra ādinā na etat bhidyate tatas kiyantam cit kālam sthāsyati iti evam rajata ādiṣu api ānumānikam eva tad rūpasya sthāyi tvam anena eva abhiprāyeṇa uktam

original: rajataṃ gṛhyamāṇaṃ hi cirasthāyīti gṛhyate|
analyzed: rajatam gṛhyamāṇam hi cira sthāyi iti gṛhyate

original: etadeva bādhakasyāpi tatvam| anumānena hyaetadavagataṃ rajatasya sato nākasmādatadbhāvaḥ saṃbhavatīti atadrūpasya vā tadrūpateti ubhayorapi kālayorekarūpamevedamiti sthite pūrvamevāvagataṃ rajatarūpamutarakālaṃ vyāpnoti utarakālāvagataścātadbhāvaḥ tatpūrvakālam|
analyzed: etat eva bādhakasya api anumānena hi a etad avagatam rajatasya sataḥ na akasmāt a tadbhāvaḥ saṃbhavati iti atadrūpasya vā tad rūpa tā iti ubhayoḥ api kālayoḥ eka rūpam eva idam iti sthite pūrvam eva avagatam rajata rūpam utara kālam vyāpnoti utara kāla avagataḥ ca atadbhāvaḥ tad pūrva kālam

original: tena samānaviṣayatayā pūrvāvagatasya rajatarūpasya bhavatyutarakālabhuvā nedaṃ rajatamityanena bādhaḥ| yatra tvanumānenaikarūpatvaṃ na kāladvaye'pi vastuno'vagataṃ tatra na bhavatyeva bādhaḥ| yathā badaraphale śyāmapratyayasya pākakālabhuvā raktapratyayena| pratyakṣeṇa tu sthāyitvāvagame tatrāpi bādhaḥ syāt|
analyzed: tena samāna viṣaya tayā pūrva avagatasya rajata rūpasya bhavati utara kāla bhuvā na idam rajatam iti anena bādhaḥ yatra tu anumānena eka rūpa tvam na kāla dvaye pi vastunā uvagatam tatra na bhavati eva bādhaḥ yathā badara phale śyāma pratyayasya pāka kāla bhuvā rakta pratyayena pratyakṣeṇa tu sthāyi tva avagame tatra api bādhaḥ syāt

original: tasmānna pratyakṣeṇa sthāyitvaṃ svadhyavasānam| evaṃ niyamo'pi sarvadeśakālavyāptirūpatvānna| nanu svābhāvikatvaṃ saṃbandhasya niyamaḥ na tu kālāntarasambandhastacca vartamānameveti yuktaṃ yatpratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate| kiṃ punaridaṃ svābhāvikatvaṃ na tāvatsadātanatvaṃ kādācitkasya tadayogāt|
analyzed: tasmāt na pratyakṣeṇa sthāyi tvam su adhyavasānam evam niyamaḥ api sarva deśa kāla vyāpti rūpatvāt na nanu svābhāvika tvam saṃbandhasya niyamaḥ na tu kāla antara sambandhaḥ tat ca vartamānam eva iti yuktam yat pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate kim punar idam svābhāvika tvam na tāvat sadātana tvam kādācitkasya tad ayogāt

original: atha svarūpanimitatvam agnerapi dhūmasaṃbandhe svarūpaṃ nimitamiti tasyāpi dhūmasaṃbandho niyataḥ syāt| nanvārdreandhanādikṛto'sya
analyzed: atha sva rūpa nimita tvam agneḥ api dhūma saṃbandhe sva rūpam nimitam iti tasya api dhūma saṃbandhaḥ niyataḥ syāt nanu ārdreandhana ādi kṛtaḥ sya

original: dhūmasambandho  na svarūpanimitaḥ satyam ārdreandhanādinimitaṃ svarūpamiti nimitameva| na hyasita saṃbandhisvarūpe sambandho bhavati| svarūpadharmatvamiti cet sa eva doṣaḥ| agnisvarūpasyāpi dharma eva saṃyogaḥ|
analyzed: dhūma sambandhaḥ na sva rūpa nimitaḥ satyam ārdreandhana ādi nimitam sva rūpam iti nimitam eva na hi asita saṃbandhi sva rūpe sambandhaḥ bhavati sva rūpa dharma tvam iti ced saḥ eva doṣaḥ agni sva rūpasya api dharmaḥ eva saṃyogaḥ

original: atha svarūpapaikānimitakaḥ sambandhaḥ svābhāvikaḥ vahnestu dhūmasaṃbandhe svarūpātirikto'pyārdreandhanādirastyeva hetuḥ dhūmasya vahnisambandhe svarūpameva nimitam na nimitāntaramastīti matamevantarhi pratyakṣagamyaṃ svābhāvikatvaṃ na hi tena nimitāntarābhāvaḥ śakyate pratyetuṃ bhāvaviṣayatvātpratyakṣasya|
analyzed: atha sva rūpa paika animitakaḥ sambandhaḥ svābhāvikaḥ vahneḥ tu dhūma saṃbandhe sva rūpa atiriktaḥ api ārdreandhana ādiḥ asti eva hetuḥ dhūmasya vahni sambandhe sva rūpam eva nimitam na nimita antaram asti iti matam eva tarhi pratyakṣa gamyam svābhāvika tvam na hi tena nimita antara abhāvaḥ śakyate pratyetum bhāva viṣaya tvāt pratyakṣasya

original: dṛśyādarśanātu nimitāntarācchabhāvaḥ pratīyataiti pratyakṣagamyatvānupapatiḥ| api ca dhūmasyāgnisambandhe na svarūpameva nimitamagnyādīnāmapi nimitatvāt| tasmātsvarūpāvyabhicāra eva svabhāvikatvam| avyabhicāraśca sakalataddeśakālavyāptiriti pratyakṣagamyatvānupapatiḥ tasya vartamānaviṣayatvāt|

original: padapadārthavyutpatiraṅgaṃ vākyādvākyārthapratītāvapītyucyate tadayuktaṃ hi vākyāntavarṇaḥ pūrvapūrvarṇajanitasaṃskārasahitaḥ smṛtyārūḍhā vā varṇāḥ padārthebhyo'rthāntaramabhidadhati tarhi padapadārthasaṃvitatra kakathamivopakāraṃ kuryāt| padārthajñānamiti cenna tenāpyupakāradarśanāt|

original: lokasiddhārthābhidhāyibhiḥ padaireva tadupapateḥ| kathaṃ punastairapūrvavākyārthavagatistatra ṭīkākārastāvadāha|

original: yadanvitābhidhāyitvaṃ bhavateṣyate tatpadasaṃghātastadarthasaṃghātasyābhidhāyaka iti śakyate eva saṅgatirasmābhiravagantumiti na kaścidviśeṣaḥ| satyametat śaktikalpanāgauravātu kanaitadupapadyataityuktam|
analyzed: yad anvita abhidhāyi tvam bhavatā iṣyate tad pada saṃghātaḥ tad artha saṃghātasya abhidhāyakaḥ iti śakyate eva saṅgatiḥ asmābhiḥ avagantum iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ satyam etat śakti kalpanā gauravāt tu kanā etat upapadyate iti uktam

original: anvitābhidhānamapi tarhyanupapannaṃ gauravādeva svarūpamātrameva tu lāghavātpadānāmabhidheyaṃ varamāśritaṃ tanna anvitapratipaternirmūlatvaprasaṅgāt| na hi tasyā mūlāntaramulabhyate svarūpeṇaiva padairabhihitāḥ padārthāḥ parasparavyatiṣaktamātmānaṃ pratipādayantīti cet na adarśanāt|
analyzed: anvita abhidhānam api tarhi anupapannam gauravāt eva sva rūpa mātram eva tu lāghavāt padānām abhidheyam varam āśritam tat na anvita pratipateḥ nirmūla tva prasaṅgāt na hi tasyāḥ mūla antaram ulabhyate sva rūpeṇa eva padaiḥ abhihitāḥ padārthāḥ paraspara vyatiṣaktam ātmānam pratipādayanti iti ced na adarśanāt

original: pramāṇāntaravijñātaiḥ padārthairna hi dṛśyate|

original: vākyārthavedanaṃ śabdapratīteḥ kāraṇantvatha||7||

original: śaktitrayaṃ prakalpyaṃ syātpadānāmarthagocarā|

original: arthānāmanvite śaktistadādhāyakatā pade||8||

original: na hi pramāṇāntarāvagatānāṃ pratilabdhākāṅkṣāditrayasahāyānāmapi vyatiṣaṅgapratipādakatvaṃ daśyate na hi devadatamupalabhya ko'sya pitetyapekṣamāṇaḥ sananihitamapi yajñadataṃ yogyamapi sahasaivādhyavasyati pitaram|
analyzed: na hi pramāṇa antara avagatānām pratilabdha ākāṅkṣā ādi traya sahāyānām api vyatiṣaṅga pratipādaka tvam daśyate na hi devadatam upalabhya kaḥ sya pitā iti apekṣamāṇaḥ sana nihitam api yajñadatam yogyam api sahasā eva adhyavasyati pitaram

original: athānyatrāviditamapi śabdapratītānāmevārthānāmanvitapratipatikāraṇatvaṃ kalpyataiti te matam evantarhi śaktitrayamadṛṣṭaṃ kalpitaṃ syāt| padānāntāvatpadārthābhidhānaśaktiḥ arthānāñcānvitapratipādanaśaktiḥ padānāñca punastaccchaktyādhāyakatvaśaktiriti kalpanāgauravādvaramekaiva padānāmanvitagocarā śaktirabhyupagatā|
analyzed: atha anyatra aviditam api śabda pratītānām eva arthānām anvita pratipati kāraṇatvam kalpyate eti te matam evam tarhi śakti trayam adṛṣṭam kalpitam syāt padānām tāvat padārtha abhidhāna śaktiḥ arthānām ca anvita pratipādana śaktiḥ padānām ca punar tad śakti ādhāyaka tva śaktiḥ iti kalpanā gauravāt varam ekā eva padānām anvita gocarā śaktiḥ abhyupagatā

original: na tvayā'nvatagocaraṃ śaktidvayaṃ kalpitavyam tatkathamekā śaktirityucyate satyametatathā'pi śaktitrayakalpanāllāghamastyeva| kiñca na pṛthaganvaye śaktiḥ kalpityavyā| ekaiva tu śaktiranvitaparyantā kalpyate ataḥ kalpanālāghavādanvitābhidhāyitvameva varam|
analyzed: na śakti dvayam kalpitavyam tat katham ekā śaktiḥ iti ucyate satyam etad tathā api śakti traya kalpanāt lāgham asti eva kiñca na pṛthak anvaye śaktiḥ ekā eva tu śaktiḥ anvita paryantā kalpyate atas kalpanā lāghavāt anvita abhidhāyi tvam eva varam

original: yadyapi kathañciccchaktikalpanā samānā bhavet tathā'pi prathamāvagatānāmabhyupetatātparyāṇāca padānāmevānvitābhidhāyakatvaṃ yuktamevāṅgīkartum| evañca śābdatvamapi vākyārthasya samañjasaṃ bhaviṣyati itarathā kiṣṭaṃ syāt| nanu sāmānyaṃ padārthastacca nāntareṇa viśeṣamātmānaṃ labhate iti tadviśeṣamākṣipati viśeṣa eva ca vākyārtha ityucyate|
analyzed: yadi api kathañcid śakti kalpanā samānā bhavet tathā api prathama avagatānām abhyupeta tātparyāṇāḥ ca padānām eva anvita abhidhāyaka tvam yuktam eva aṅgīkartum evam ca śābdatvam api vākya arthasya samañjasam bhaviṣyati itarathā kim ṭam syāt nanu sāmānyam padārthaḥ tat ca na antareṇa viśeṣam ātmānam labhate iti tat viśeṣam ākṣipati viśeṣaḥ eva ca vākya arthaḥ iti ucyate

original: padārthasvarūpaṃ hi sarvāvasthānāṃ sāmānyam anvitatā cāsyāvasthāviśeṣa iti padārtha eva vākyārthe pramāṇamiti| naitadyauktam| yadyapi sāmānyaṃ viśeṣamākṣipati tathā'pi asti kaścidviśeṣa ityetāvanmātramākṣipyeta niyataikaviśeṣaviṣayākṣepastu durlabha eva pramāṇābhāvāt tena gāmānayeti gavaivānvitamānayanaṃ na pratīyate|
analyzed: padārtha svarūpam hi sarva avasthānām sāmānyam anvita tā ca asya avasthā viśeṣaḥ iti padārthaḥ eva vākya arthe pramāṇam iti na etat yauktam yadi api sāmānyam viśeṣam ākṣipati tathā api asti kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti etāvat mātram ākṣipyeta niyata eka viśeṣa viṣaya ākṣepaḥ tu durlabhaḥ eva pramāṇa abhāvāt tena gām ānaya iti gavā eva anvitam ānayanam na pratīyate

original: matpakṣe tvākāṅkṣādyaupalakṣaṇaśālinaivārthāntareṇānvitaṃ padasyābhidheyamiti yuktam yadgavānvitamānayanaṃ pratīyate gaurhi svapadena sannihito nārthāntaramiti niyatāvagati siddhiḥ||
analyzed: mad pakṣe tu ākāṅkṣā ādi aupalakṣaṇa śālinā eva artha antareṇa anvitam padasya abhidheyam iti yuktam yat gavā anvitam ānayanam pratīyate gauḥ hi sva padena sannihitaḥ na artha antaram iti niyata avagati siddhiḥ

original: na ca sannidhyapekṣatve bhavedanyonyasaṃśrayaḥ|

original: na kevalābhidhānena smṛtyā'pi hi bhavedasau||9||

original: na caivaṃ vācyaṃ yadi saṃnihitenārthāntareṇānvitaṃ svārthamabhidhate tato gāmānetyatra gośabdena tāvatsvārtho
analyzed: na ca evam vācyam yadi saṃnihitena artha antareṇa anvitam sva artham abhidhate tatas gām āneti atra go śabdena tāvat svārthaḥ

original: nābhidhātavyaḥ yāvadānayatinā na svārtho'bhidheyaḥ tenāpi hi svārthe gośabdenānabhihitena svārtho'bhidheyaḥ syāditi vyaktamevetaretarāśrayamiti| na hyavaśyamabhidhānasannihitenaivarthenānvitaṃ śabdenābhidheyaṃ yato'yaṃ doṣaḥ syāt sannidhimātrasya tadupalakṣaṇatvāt| sannidheyaścāntareṇā'pyabhidhānaṃ smṛtyā'pi saṃbhavāt|

analyzed: katham anyatra avidita pradhāna kārya abhidhāna śaktīnām eva adhikāra vākyeṣu viniyukta viṣaya tve sati api pradhāna kārya abhidhānam āśrayet tena apūrvasya prādhānyam vihīyate eti kiñca upapadyate eva yāgasya akaraṇa bhūtasya api viṣaya tvam niyogaḥ hi phala sādhanam tasya yāgaḥ svarūpeṇa eva viṣayaḥ iti kin nā upapadyate

original: tainekayaiva kṛtyaikabhāvārthagocarayā'pūrvaṃ phalaṃ ca sādhyataiti apūrvaviṣayasya bhāvārthasya phalakaraṇatvamuktamaṃ bhavatitatkaraṇatvaṃ viṣapuraḥsaramiti viṣayabhūtasya karaṇatvaprasaṅgaḥ| avaśyaṃ cāpūrvakaraṇatvapuraḥsarameva yāstasyā kālāntarabhāvini phale sādhanatvaṃ sambhāvyeta|
analyzed: taiḥ ekayā eva kṛtyā eka bhāvārtha gocarayā apūrvam phalam ca sādhyate eti apūrva viṣayasya bhāvārthasya phala karaṇa tvam uktamam bhavati tad karaṇa tvam viṣa puraḥsaram iti viṣaya bhūtasya karaṇa tva prasaṅgaḥ avaśyam ca apūrva karaṇa tva puraḥsaram eva yāḥ tasyāḥ kāla antara bhāvini phale sādhana tvam sambhāvyeta

original: nanvalabdhe dvāre mā nāma sambhūt labdhe tu kimiti na sambhavati kimatra dvāraṃ labdhaṃ kintadapūrvaṃ tatvāntaraṃ vā tatvāntaratve tāvatat eva yāgasya karaṇatvopapaterdeayajalāñjalyapūrvaṃ prasajyeta| apūrvadvāreṇa tu phalasādhanatvamapūrvasādhanatvanirūpaṇādhīnanirūpaṇam|
analyzed: nanu alabdhe dvāre mā nāma sambhūt labdhe tu kim iti na sambhavati kim atra dvāram labdham kin tat apūrvam tatva antaram vā tatva antara tve tāvatat eva yāgasya karaṇa tva upapateḥ prasajyeta apūrva dvāreṇa tu phala sādhanatvam apūrva sādhanatva nirūpaṇa adhīna nirūpaṇam

original: taddhi tasya dvāramucyate yadyena svaphaloddeśapravṛtena tasiddhyarthamantare sādhyate tadevaṃ satyapi yadyatra karaṇībhūtasya viṣayatvamucyate
analyzed: tat hi tasya dvāram ucyate yat yena sva phala uddeśa pravṛtena antare sādhyate tat evam sati api yat yatra karaṇībhūtasya viṣaya tvam ucyate

original: tataḥ phalakaraṇatvādhīnaṃ niyogaviṣayatvaṃ tadadhīnañca niyogaṃ prati karaṇatvaṃ tadadhīnañca phalakaraṇatvamiti cakrakamāpadyeta| kiñcaivamaṅgalope viṣayavilayaṃ bruvāṇaḥ praṣṭavyaḥ kimaṅgaviśiṣṭasya vilayatvamuta tadupalakṣitasyeti|
analyzed: tatas phala karaṇa tva adhīnam niyoga viṣaya tvam tad adhīnam ca niyogam prati karaṇa tvam tad adhīnam ca phala karaṇa tvam iti cakrakam āpadyeta kiñca evam aṅga lope viṣaya vilayam bruvāṇaḥ praṣṭavyaḥ kim aṅga viśiṣṭasya vilaya tvam uta tad upalakṣitasya iti

original: kiñcātaḥ yadi tāvadaṅgaviśiṣṭasya tataḥ sarveṣāmeva prayājādīnāmāgneyādīnāñca samaprādhānyaṃ prasajyeta guṇādhikāravat| yathā hi tadhiviśiṣṭahomasyendriyakāmāpūrvasādhanatve dadhihomayorapi samaprādhānyaṃ na guṇapradhānabhāvaḥ tadvadihāpi syāt| athāṅgopalakṣitasya yāgasvarūpasya tarhi roḍāśāpāye'pyanapāyānnāstyaṅgalope viṣayavilayaḥ|
analyzed: kiñca atas yadi tāvat aṅga viśiṣṭasya tatas sarveṣām eva prayāja ādīnām āgneya ādīnām ca sama prādhānyam prasajyeta guṇa adhikāra vat yathā hi tadhi viśiṣṭa homasya indriya kāma apūrva sādhana tve dadhi homayoḥ api sama prādhānyam na guṇa pradhāna bhāvaḥ tadvat iha api syāt atha aṅga upalakṣitasya yāga svarūpasya tarhi roḍa āśā apāye pi anapāyāt na asti aṅga lope viṣaya vilayaḥ

original: kiñcaivamapūrvaprayuktirapūrvagrahaṇañcāṅgānāṃ na syāt| sādhikāro vidhipratinirūddhaniyogāntaraviṣayabhāvān svārthatayā gṛhītvā svagṛhīteṣveva vrīhyādiṣu dvārabhūteṣu svarūpātikrameṇaiva svasādhanaviśeṣarūpe viniyuṅkte aṅgasambandhātu
analyzed: kiñca evam apūrva prayuktiḥ apūrva grahaṇam ca aṅgānām na syāt sa adhikāraḥ vidhi pratinirūddha niyoga antara viṣaya bhāvān svārthatayā gṛhītvā sva gṛhīteṣu eva vrīhi ādiṣu dvāra bhūteṣu sva rūpa atikrameṇa eva sva sādhana viśeṣa rūpe viniyuṅkte aṅga sambandhātu

original: prāgviṣayābhāvenāpratipanne niyoge sarvamidamajātaputrakrīḍanakamāpadyate| phalaṃ karaṇaṃ vā prayojakaṃ syādaṅgānām aprayojakabhāvenetyasyāparā vyākhyā| phalasādhanarūpe bhāvārthe niyogena saṃbaddhyamāne'rthābhidhānakarmacetyanena nyāyena tuṣopavāpavatkapālasyāprayojakaṃ sāṅgasya yāgasyāpūrvaṃ prasajyeta|
analyzed: prāk viṣaya abhāvena apratipanne niyoge sarvam idam ajāta putra krīḍanakam āpadyate phalam karaṇam vā prayojakam syāt aṅgānām aprayojaka bhāvena iti asya aparā vyākhyā phala sādhana rūpe bhāva arthe niyogena saṃbaddhyamāna īrtha abhidhāna karma ca iti anena nyāyena tuṣa upavāpa vat kapālasya aprayojakam sa aṅgasya yāgasya apūrvam prasajyeta

original: nanviṣṭameva kāmyeṣu vidheyaprayojakatvamata eva śyenasyāvidheyatvādanarthatvam| yadyapi svavidhisiddhyarthamanumīyeta1 tathā'pi na vidheyatvaṃ yasya vidhiḥ svasiddhyarthamanuṣṭhānamākṣipati tadvidheyaṃ na tu vidhisādhanamātram| kāmyeṣu tu phalata evānuṣṭhīyamānaṃ karm vidhimapi sādhayatīti na vidheyamiti|
analyzed: nanu iṣṭam eva kāmyeṣu vidheya prayojaka tvam atas eva śyenasya avidheya tvāt anartha tvam yadi api sva vidhi siddhi artham anumīyeta tathā api na vidheya tvam yasya vidhiḥ sva siddhi artham anuṣṭhānam ākṣipati tat vidheyam na tu vidhi sādhana mātram kāmyeṣu tu phalataḥ eva anuṣṭhīyamānam karm vidhim api sādhayati iti na vidheyam iti

original: kimidānīmaṅgeṣvaprayojako vidhiriṣyate sāṅgasya hi phalasādhanasya viṣayatvepagame tādṛśasyaiva phalaprayuktasyopajīvanādaṅgaprayojako vidhiraṅgānāmapi syāt| atra kaścidvaiyātyādevamāha mābhūdaṅgānāṃ vidheyatvaṃ na caitāvatā'gnīṣomīyāderniṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: kim idānīm aṅgeṣu aprayojakaḥ vidhiḥ iṣyate sa aṅgasya hi phala sādhanasya viṣaya tva apagame tādṛśasya eva phala prayuktasya upajīvanāt aṅga prayojakaḥ vidhiḥ aṅgānām api syāt atra kaścid vaiyātyāt evam āha mā abhūt aṅgānām vidheya tvam na ca etāvatā agnīṣomīya ādeḥ niṣedha prasaṅgaḥ

original: dvividhasyāpi niṣedhasyāsaṃbhāvanīyatvāt dvedhā hi kiñcitphaloddeśenānuṣṭhīyamānaṃ karm niṣidhyate phalaparyantaṃ vā sādhanamātraparyavasānaṃ vā tadyathā sukhārthaṃ madirāsvādaḥ prasakta eva niṣidhyate nānena sukhamavāpyavyam akāryametatsādhyaṃ sukhamiti|
analyzed: dvividhasya api niṣedhasya a saṃbhāvanīya tvāt dvedhā hi kiñcid phala uddeśena anuṣṭhīyamānam karma niṣidhyate phala paryantam vā sādhana mātra paryavasānam vā tat yathā sukha artham madirā āsvādaḥ prasaktaḥ eva niṣidhyate na anena sukham avāpyavyam akāryam etat sādhyam sukham iti

original: kvacitsādhanatvamātraṃ niṣidhyate tadyathā rogārtastadupaśamārthī katadupakārakaeva bheṣajabuddhyā pravartamāno niṣidhyate maivaṃ kārṣīrnedamasyopaśamasādhanamiti| tatra na tāvadagnīṣomīye phalaparyante niṣedhasaṃbhavaḥ| svargasya niratiśayasukharūpasya kāryatvena sarvajanaviditasyākāryatvābhidhāne pramāṇāntaravirodhaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: kvacid sādhanatva mātram niṣidhyate tat yathā roga ārtaḥ tad upaśama arthī bheṣaja buddhyā pravartamānaḥ niṣidhyate mā evam kārṣīḥ na idam asya upaśama sādhanam iti tatra na tāvat agnīṣomīye phala paryante niṣedha saṃbhavaḥ svargasya niratiśaya sukha rūpasya kārya tvena sarva jana viditasya akārya tva abhidhāne pramāṇa antara virodha prasaṅgāt

original: nāpi sādhanatvaniṣedhaḥ vacanavirodhāt| tasmānna niṣedhyatvamiti| tadidamatitucchṃa na nirākaraṇamapi prayojayati| tathā hi madirāsvādena saṃpādyaṃ sukhaṃ  pramāṇāntareṇa kāryaṃ viditamapyakāryamamucyate vacanena tathā svargasukhamapīti nocyate pramāmāntaraṃ hi kṣipramevāgrahaṇatayā vyākhyāyate| tasmādaṅgeṣvapyaprayojakatvamaniṣṭameva|
analyzed: nā api sādhanatva niṣedhaḥ vacana virodhāt tasmāt na niṣedhya tvam iti tat idam na nirākaraṇam api prayojayati tathā hi madirā āsvādena saṃpādyam sukham pramāṇa antareṇa kāryam viditam api akāryam amucyate vacanena tathā svarga sukham api iti nā ucyate pramām āntaram hi kṣipram evā agrahaṇatayā vyākhyāyate tasmāt aṅgeṣu api aprayojaka tvam aniṣṭam eva

original: tañcāpadyetāṅgaviśiṣṭasya viṣayatve| āha satyamaṅgaviśiṣṭasya viṣayatve samaprādhānyamaprayojakatvaṃ ca syāt| na tu tadviśiṣṭo viṣayaḥ karaṇībhūtastu viṣayaḥ tadbhāvaścāṅgalope lupyāt ityaṅgalope liṣayavilaya ityucyate na tvaṅgalope tasyaiva viṣayatvaṃ tasmādadoṣa iti|
analyzed: tat ca āpadyeta aṅga viśiṣṭasya viṣaya tve āha satyam aṅga viśiṣṭasya viṣaya tve sama prādhānyam aprayojaka tvam ca syāt na tu tad viśiṣṭaḥ viṣayaḥ karaṇībhūtaḥ tu viṣayaḥ tad bhāvaḥ ca aṅga lope lupyāt iti aṅga lope iti ucyate na tu aṅga lope tasya eva viṣaya tvam tasmāt adoṣaḥ iti

original: naitadyauktaṃ yadyaṅgalope karaṇatvaṃ nāsti nitye'pi tarhi hīnāṅgasya karaṇatvaṃ nāstītyananuṣṭhānaṃ syāt| atha tatra vidhinā yāvadaṅga prāpyate tadupetasyaiva karaṇatvaṃ bhavati taditaratrāpi kiyadbhiraṅgairupetasya karaṇatvaṃ dvidhigṛhītānāmevāṅgānāṃ saṃgrahaṇādyāvantyaṅgāni vidhinā prāpyante tadupetasyaiva karaṇatvaṃ bhavatīti
analyzed: na etat yauktam yadi aṅga lope karaṇa tvam na asti nitye api tarhi hīna aṅgasya karaṇa tvam na asti iti ananuṣṭhānam syāt atha tatra vidhinā yāvat aṅga prāpyate tad upetasya eva karaṇa tvam bhavati tat itaratra api kiyadbhiḥ aṅgaiḥ upetasya karaṇa tvam dvidhi gṛhītānām eva aṅgānām saṃgrahaṇāt yāvanti aṅgāni vidhinā prāpyante tad upetasya eva karaṇa tvam bhavati iti

original: nāstyaṅgalope viṣayavilayaḥ| kiñca jāteṣṭau saṃvalitādhikārābhyupagamātkaraṇībhutasyaiva viṣayatvamiti na yathāśakti prayogaḥ syāt| tataścāṅgasaṃpatyarthamevotkarṣasya vaktuaṃ śakyatvāccheṣivirodhena nimitasvabhāvabhaṅgārthamādyamadhikaraṇamanarthakaṃ syāt| nanu tatra nimitaśravaṇabalādaṅgahānaṃ syāt|
analyzed: na asti aṅga lope viṣaya vilayaḥ kiñca jāta iṣṭau saṃvalita adhikāra abhyupagamāt karaṇībhutasya eva viṣaya tvam iti na yathāśakti prayogaḥ syāt tatas ca aṅga saṃpati artham evā utkarṣasya śakya tvāt śeṣi virodhena nimita svabhāva bhaṅga artham ādyam adhikaraṇam anarthakam syāt nanu tatra nimita śravaṇa balāt aṅga hānam syāt

original: na śrute'pi nimite naimitikameva kartavyaṃ nānyat karaṇībhūtabhāvārthaviṣayañca kāryaṃ naimitikamiti kuto'nīdṛśasyānuṣṭhānamityalamanena karaṇībhūtaviṣayatvena|
analyzed: na śrute api nimite naimitikam eva kartavyam na anyat karaṇībhūta bhāva artha viṣayam ca kāryam naimitikam iti kutas nīdṛśasya anuṣṭhānam iti alam anena karaṇībhūta viṣaya tvena

original: svarūpeṇa bhāvyamitikartavyatayā sambandhumarhati| na hi bhavatyapūrvaṃ kathamiti| bhavati tu bhāvayetkathamiti| nanu svargaṃ bhāvayediti brūyurbhāvanā ca kaphalasyocyataityevamādibhistatra tatra bhāṣyakāreṇa phalasya bhāvyatvābhidhānāt bhāvyaprayuktamitikartavyatājātaṃ phalaprayuktaṃ syānnāpūrvaprayuktam| ucyate|

original: tatrāpi ca karaṇopakārakatvenaiva tadupakārakatvaṃ sambhavatīti karaṇopakārakatvaṃ bhāvanāṅgatvenāvagatānāṃ prayājādīnāṃ tādarthyanirvāhāya paścātkalpyate| āha ca|

original: tatra yadi darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ śrutābhyāmekavākyatāyāmākāṅkṣā paryyavasyet tato'dhyāhṛtenopakāreṇa syādekavākyatā| yathoktena tu mārgeṇa darśapūrṇamāsaikavākyatāyāmāṅkṣāparyyavasānamubhayorbhavati| apekṣito'pi prathamamupakāro na kena cidapi samarpitaḥ yena prayājavākyenaikavākyatayā'nviyāt|

original: tena darśapūrṇamāsaprayājavākyayorekavākyatāyāṃ guṇapradhānabhāvena niṣpannāyāṃ paścādapekṣitopakāranirvṛtiḥ| āha ca| darśapūrṇmāsayorūpakāramapekṣamāṇayoḥ prayājādiṣu vopakāryyamapekṣamāṇeṣvaniṣpannāvastha evopakāre prakaraṇātāvatādarthyaṃ pratīyate| tadanyathānupapateḥ karaṇopakāraḥ kalpyate|

original: tena prayājādyauddeśena śrutyādibhiḥ kiṃ cidaṅgamutkvā madhye kiṃ cidasaṃyuktaṃ vidhāya punarante prayājādyauddeśenāṅge vihite madyasthasyāsaṃyuktasyāṅgasyāvāntaraprakaraṇātprayājādyaṅgatā bhavati|

analyzed: pratyabhijñā śaṅkayā na drāk iva apūrva antaram pratīyate eti ced etat eva tarhi prathamam nirūpayitavyam anena tāvat kāryam abhidhīyate tat kim prakṛtam eva adhikāra apūrvam uta anyat iti tatra yadi kāraka dvāreṇa tad viṣaya anupraveśam saṃbhāvayet tatas pratyabhijñāna sāmarthyāt viṣayasya viniyogam avaghāta vat anumanyate

original: atha tu pratyatnena mṛgayamāṇo na tadviṣayānupraveśadvāraṃ paśyati tataḥ pratyabhijñābādhena niyogāntarameva pradhānabhūtaṃ samidyāgaviṣayamadhyavasyati| itarathā śrutibādhaprasaṅgāt parihṛtya hi śrutibādhaṃ ca grāhako gṛhṇāti na tadbādhenāpi virodhāśaṅkāyām| atra ca śrutyā prathamaṃ tāvada grāhakasya virodhaḥ śaṅkyate|
analyzed: atha tu pratyatnena mṛgayamāṇaḥ na tad viṣaya anupraveśa dvāram paśyati tatas pratyabhijñā bādhena niyoga antaram eva pradhāna bhūtam samidh yāga viṣayam adhyavasyati itarathā śruti bādha prasaṅgāt parihṛtya hi śruti bādham ca grāhakaḥ gṛhṇāti na tad bādhena api virodha āśaṅkāyām atra ca śrutyā prathamam tāvat a grāhakasya virodhaḥ śaṅkyate

original: grahaṇe pratipadaḥ  saṃjāte tadbalenaiva dvitvaśruterlakṣaṇakatvapratipādakatvaṃ patnyabhiprāyatvaṃ vā prasajyeta| virodha eva tatra niścito na śaṅkāmātramiti cet| kathaṃ

original: tarhyadhikaraṇārambhaḥ| na hi nirṇīte nyāyena vicāraḥ saṃbhavati satyapi saṃdehe paścādvirodhanirṇayaḥ pratipadīva samidyāge'pi bhavati| yadi manyeta na samidādiṣu prathamaṃ sandehaḥ| kintarhi sannidhānātprakṛtāpūrvamevedamiti bhrāntirbhavati tataścāvirodhād grāhakagrahaṇamiti|
analyzed: tarhi adhikaraṇa ārambhaḥ na hi nirṇīte nyāyena vicāraḥ saṃbhavati sati api saṃdehe paścāt virodha nirṇayaḥ pratipadi iva samidh yāge api bhavati yadi manyeta na samidh ādiṣu prathamam sandehaḥ kin tarhi sannidhānāt prakṛta apūrvam eva idam iti bhrāntiḥ bhavati tatas ca avirodhāt grāhaka grahaṇam iti

original: tathā'pi paścādvirodhadarśanene tadvyāvartate yathā pūrvapakṣanyāyena niścite pratipadaḥ prakaraṇagrahaṇe siddhāntanyāyena śrutivirodhapratibhāse sati tādarthyaṃ vyāvartate|
analyzed: tathā api paścāt virodha darśanena i tat vyāvartate yathā pūrvapakṣa nyāyena niścite pratipadaḥ prakaraṇa grahaṇe siddhānta nyāyena śruti virodha pratibhāse sati tādarthyam vyāvartate

original: rki ca yadi niyogāntaramavaghātādivapratipannaṃ tatastadvākyagāmināmavahantyādiśabdānāmiva prayājādivākyagatānāmapi yajyādiśabdānāṃ pradhānāpūrvānvitasvārthābhidhāyakatvaṃ kiṃ nābhyupagamyate| eṣā hi tatra yuktiḥ| yadyeṣāṃ pradhānāpūrvānvitasvārthābhidhāyitvaṃ syāt| tathā satyutpatāvevānyatiraścīnatayā'vagatasya niyogāntaraviṣayatā na syāt|
analyzed: ca yadi niyoga antaram avaghātāt iva pratipannam tatas tad vākya gāminām avahanti ādi śabdānām iva prayāja ādi vākya gatānām api yaji ādi śabdānām pradhāna apūrva anvita sva artha abhidhāyaka tvam kim na abhyupagamyate eṣā hi tatra yuktiḥ yadi eṣām pradhāna apūrva anvita sva artha abhidhāyi tvam syāt tathā sati utpatau eva anya tiraścīna tayā avagatasya niyoga antara viṣaya tā na syāt

original: kāryadvaye saṃbandhānupapateḥ| na hyaekaṃ vastu yugapat kāryadvayasaṃbandhi pratyetuṃ śakyamiti| idaṃ ca pratīte niyogāntare śakyamabhidhātuṃ nāpratīte| tena yadi niyogāntaramapratipannaṃ tato virodhābhāvādyajiśabdasya samidvākyagatasya pradhānāpūrvānvitasvārthābhidhāyutvam avahantyādivatsyāt|
analyzed: kārya dvaye saṃbandha anupapateḥ na hi a ekam vastu yugapad kārya dvaya saṃbandhi pratyetum śakyam iti idam ca pratīte niyoga antare śakyam abhidhātum na apratīte tena yadi niyoga antaram apratipannam tatas virodha abhāvāt yaji śabdasya samidh vākya gatasya pradhāna apūrva anvita svārtha abhidhā āyu tvam avahanti ādi vat syāt

original: atha pratipannaṃ tataḥ śrutivirodhe grāhakagrahaṇānupapatiriti seyamubhayataḥ pāśā rajjuriti| atha prathamamapratipanne'pūrvāntare yajerevādhikārāpūrvānvitasvārthābhidhāyitvamavagatamapi paścānniyogāntarāvagatyā bādhyate tato grāhakagrahaṇamapi śrutivirodhādbādhitatvam| tasmānna kathaṃ cidapi prayājādīnāmaṅgatvaṃ saṃbhavati|
analyzed: atha pratipannam tatas śruti virodhe grāhaka grahaṇa anupapatiḥ iti sā iyam ubhayatas pāśāḥ rajjuḥ iti atha prathamam apratipanna ipūrva antare yajeḥ eva adhikāra apūrva anvita sva artha abhidhāyi tvam avagatam api paścāt niyoga antara avagatyā bādhyate tatas grāhaka grahaṇam api śruti virodhāt bādhita tvam tasmāt na katham cit api prayāja ādīnām aṅga tvam saṃbhavati

original: yadipi ca na cāvihitamaṅgaṃ bhavatītyetadanṛtavadanapratiṣethamādhikṛtyābhihitam| ārādupakārakaviṣayakānuvādabhidhānaṃ tu jañjabhyamānamantravacanādhikāratsannipātiviṣaymiti tatāvanmātrālocanenoktam| anyathā kathaṃ tadutsargge karmmāṇītyatrārādupakārakamevābhipretya puruṣaprayatno'nuvāda iti vadatyeva bhāṣyakāra iti naivaṃ vyākhyātuṃ śakyate|
analyzed: ca na ca avihitam aṅgam bhavati iti etat anṛta vadana pratiṣetham ādhikṛtya abhihitam ārāt upakāraka viṣayaka anuvāda abhidhānam tu jañjabhyamāna mantra vacana adhikāra t sannipāti viṣaym iti tatāvat mātra ālocanena uktam anyathā katham tad utsargge karmmāṇi iti atra ārāt upakārakam eva abhipretya puruṣa prayatnaḥ anuvādaḥ iti vadati eva bhāṣyakāraḥ iti na evam vyākhyātum śakyate

original: kathaṃ tarhi vyākhyeyaṃ viniyogābhiprāyaṃ vidhyabhidhānamitarañca prayogābhiprāyam ityevametat vyākhyeyam| na hyasati vidhau samidādīnāṃ somādīnāmivāṅgatvaṃ sidhyati| yathā somena yajeteti yajividhyatirekeṇa somasya vidhyabhāve'pi tṛtīyayā viniyuktasya pradhānavidhinaiva vidhānam|
analyzed: katham tarhi vyākhyeyam viniyoga abhiprāyam vidhi abhidhānam itarat ca prayoga abhiprāyam iti evam etat vyākhyeyam na hi asati vidhau samidh ādīnām soma ādīnām iva aṅga tvam sidhyati yathā somena yajeta iti yaji vidhi atirekeṇa somasya vidhi abhāve api tṛtīyayā viniyuktasya pradhāna vidhinā eva vidhānam

original: evaṃ prayājādīnāmapi prakaraṇena darśapūrṇamāsayorviniyoge sati viśiṣṭapradhānavidhereva viśeṣaṇabhūtānāṃ prayājādīnāṃ vidhisiddhernārthaḥ pṛthagvidhāneneti cet| satyaṃ viśiṣṭavidhirviśeṣaṇamāskandati viśeṣaṇatvameva tu narte
analyzed: evam prayāja ādīnām api prakaraṇena darśa pūrṇamāsayoḥ viniyoge sati viśiṣṭa pradhāna vidheḥ eva viśeṣaṇa bhūtānām prayāja ādīnām vidhi siddheḥ na arthaḥ pṛthak vidhānena iti ced satyam viśiṣṭa vidhiḥ viśeṣaṇam āskandati viśeṣaṇa tvam eva tu na ṛte

original: vidhānātsidhyati| sidhyati prakaraṇeneti cet| na tasyaiva vidhyadhīnatvāt| sākāṅkṣasya hi sākāṅkṣe viniyogaḥ prakaraṇārthaḥ na ca vidhividhurāṇāmahgānāṃ prayojāpekṣā'sti samānapadopanītaṃ dhātvarthameva bhāvyaṃ samāsādya bhāvanāyāḥ parituṣṭatvāt| vidhyupahitā katatu na tāvanmātreṇa parituṣyatatīti bhavati prayojanāpekṣā|
analyzed: vidhānāt sidhyati sidhyati prakaraṇena iti ced na tasya eva vidhi adhīna tvāt sākāṅkṣasya hi sākāṅkṣe viniyogaḥ prakaraṇa arthaḥ na ca vidhi vidhurāṇām ahgānām prayojā apekṣā asti samāna pada upanītam dhātvartham eva bhāvyam samāsādya bhāvanāyāḥ parituṣṭa tvāt vidhi upahitā na tāvat mātreṇa parituṣyatati iti bhavati prayojana apekṣā

original: satyāṃ ca tasyāṃ prakaraṇena darśapūrṇamāsayorviniyogādaṅgatvaṃ prayājādīnāṃ sidhyati tasmādaṅgatvasidhyarthameva samidādiṣu vidhinā bhavitavyamiti| evamaṅgabhūteṣu teṣu viśiṣṭapradhānavidhinaiva prayogasiddheḥ tasminnaṃśeṅgavidhiranuvādo'bhidhīyate| tasmādubhayamupapannamiti sarvamavadātam| tatprakaraṇameva prayājādīnāṃ viniyojakamiti|
analyzed: satyām ca tasyām prakaraṇena darśa pūrṇamāsayoḥ viniyogāt aṅga tvam prayāja ādīnām sidhyati tasmāt aṅga tva sidhi artham eva samidh ādiṣu vidhinā bhavitavyam iti evam aṅga bhūteṣu teṣu viśiṣṭa pradhāna vidhinā eva prayoga siddheḥ tasmin aṃśa iṅga vidhiḥ anuvādaḥ abhidhīyate tasmāt ubhayam upapannam iti sarvam avadātam tat prakaraṇam eva prayāja ādīnām viniyojakam iti

original: kramastu deśasāmānyalakṣaṇaḥ sa ca dvividhaḥ pāṭhasādeśyamanuṣṭhānasādeśyamiti pūrvaṃ tāvadyatrāṅgāṅginoḥ samānadeśe pāṭhaḥ yathā

original: dabdhimantrasyopāṃśuyājasya ca utaramapi yatra samānamanuṣṭhānaṃ śeṣaśeṣiṇorbhavati yathā daikṣasya paśoḥ paśudharmāṇāṃ ca| dvividhenāpi sādeśyena dabdhimantrasya paśudharmāṇāṃ copāṃśuyāje'gnīṣomīye ca viniyogo bhavati|

original: samākhyā nāma yaugikī saṃjñā sā ca laukikī vaidikī ca yathā hotṛcamasa iti yathā''dhvaryavamiti tayā camasabhakṣaṇe hotuḥ padārthakaraṇe cādhvaryorviniyoga iti| yastu vidhivyāpāramupādānābhidhānaṃ saptamaṃ pramāṇaṃ viniyoge manyate tasyotaraṃ prameyāsaṃbhavāt| yadapyucyate tatkṛtaṃ kaca prokṣaṇādeḥ kratvarthamiti|
analyzed: samākhyā nāma yaugikī saṃjñā sā ca laukikī vaidikī ca yathā hotṛ camasaḥ iti yathā ādhvaryavam iti tayā camasa bhakṣaṇe hotuḥ padārtha karaṇe ca adhvaryoḥ viniyogaḥ iti yaḥ tu vidhi vyāpāram upādāna abhidhānam saptamam pramāṇam viniyoge manyate prameya asaṃbhavāt yat api ucyate tat kṛtam prokṣaṇa ādeḥ kratu artham iti

original: tadapyayuktaṃ śrutyaivāpūrvasādhanarūpe viniyogāt| etadeva hi tatsādhanarūpaśeṣatvaṃ yataraddvāreṇa pūrvaśeṣatvam| tathā'pi kathaṃ kratvarthatvam ucyate| vrīhīṇāṃ taṇḍulapiṣṭapuroḍāśādiyāgapraṇālikayā'pūravasādhanatvam|

analyzed: tathāvidhān ca uddiśya vidhīyamānam prokṣaṇam sarvasya dvāra dvāri bhāva avasthitasya aṅgam bhavati katham ca upādānena kratu artha tvam prokṣaṇa ādeḥ yadi matam niyoga aidamarthyam tāvat grāhaka grahaṇena eva prokṣaṇa ādeḥ avagatam karaṇatayā na saṃbhavati pāriseṣyāt karaṇa upakāraka tvanā eva tādarthyam nirvahati iti niyogaḥ eva tad anvitaḥ pratipannaḥ tasya

original: tarhi prayājāderviniyogaḥ prākaraṇikaḥ syāt| na hi prakaraṇakalpitopakārajananamātreṇa prakaraṇaviniyogaḥ sidhyati| sarveṣāmeva sannipātināmanārabhyādhītānāṃ cāṅgānāṃ tajjanakatvena prakaraṇaviniyogaprasaṅgāt| ataḥ prākaramikameva prokṣaṇāderaṅgatvam| nanvasaṃyuktaṃ prakaraṇena viniyujyate saṃyuktaṃ ca prokṣaṇamiti| naiṣaḥ doṣaḥ|

original: tata eva svargakāmaśabdaḥ pakṣadvaye'pi na puruṣaparaḥ kiṃ tu svargaparaḥ | guṇapradhānabhāve tu vivādaḥ | ata evoktaṃ kiṃ svargo guṇataḥ karmma pradhānataḥ uta karmma guṇataḥ svargaḥ
analyzed: tatas eva svarga kāma śabdaḥ pakṣa dvaye pi na puruṣa paraḥ kim tu svarga paraḥ guṇa pradhāna bhāve tu vivādaḥ atas eva uktam kim svargaḥ guṇataḥ karmma pradhānataḥ uta karmma guṇataḥ svargaḥ

original: pradhānata iti | kimidānīṃ śeṣitvena phalakāmasyānvayaḥ | bāḍham | kadhaṃ tarhi rājā rājasūyena svārājyakāmo yajetesādiṣu rājādiśabdena śeṣapratipādakena kāmaśabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyam | ucyate | ubhayorapi kaktṛparatvāt | kaktṛtvena hi rājña iva phalaṣasyopakāraḥ kadhaṃ bhavatīsevamarthaḥ  malinena snātavyaṃ kṣudhitenāśitavyamitivat |
analyzed: pradhānataḥ iti kim idānīm śeṣi tvena phala kāmasya anvayaḥ bāḍham kadham tarhi rājā rājasūyena svārājya kāmaḥ yajeta isādiṣu rāja ādi śabdena śeṣa pratipādakena kāma śabdasya sāmānādhikaraṇyam ucyate ubhayoḥ api kaktṛ para tvāt kaktṛ tvena hi rājñaḥ iva bhavati iti evam arthaḥ malinena snātavyam kṣudhitena aśitavyam itivat

original: yatra hi tṛtīyāśrutyā vispaṣṭe'pi kaktṛtve'bhihite  śeṣitvameva malināderbhavati tatra svargakāmādeḥ phalasamabhivyāhārakalpyakaktﬁÇatvasya na bhavatīti kuta etat | na khalu kaktﬁÇatvānvayaḥ śeṣibhāvasya paripanthisarvakārakāṇāṃ śeṣitvasaṃbhavaḥ prayājaśeṣādīnāṃprāgeva darśito yataḥ|
analyzed: yatra hi tṛtīyā śrutyā vispaṣṭe api kaktṛ tva ibhihite śeṣi tvam eva malina ādeḥ bhavati tatra svarga kāma ādeḥ phala samabhivyāhāra kalpya kaktﬁña tvasya na bhavati iti kutas etat na khalu kaktﬁña tva anvayaḥ śeṣi bhāvasya paripanthi sarva kārakāṇām śeṣi tva saṃbhavaḥ prayāja śeṣa ādīnām prāk eva darśitaḥ yatas

original: yadyevaṃ kathaṃ tarhi dvitīyā śeṣivibhaktiḥ tūtīyādayastu śeṣavibhaktaya iti viseṣasiddiḥ| ucyate| sādhyasādhanabhāvapratipādanādupapanno viśeṣaḥ| dviti yā hi sādhya bhāvaṃ pratipādayati sādhyatvaṃ ca śeṣitvaṃ saṃbhavati tena tadabhidhāyinyā vditīyayā tadavagatiryuktaiva |
analyzed: yadi evam katham tarhi dvitīyā śeṣi vibhaktiḥ tūtīya ādayaḥ tu śeṣa vibhaktayaḥ iti viseṣa siddiḥ ucyate sādhya sādhana bhāva pratipādanāt upapannaḥ viśeṣaḥ yā hi sādhya bhāvam pratipādayati sādhya tvam ca śeṣi tvam saṃbhavati tena tad abhidhāyinyā tad avagatiḥ yuktā eva

original: tūtīyādayastu śeṣabhāva pratyāsannasādhanatvābhidhānātatpramāṇatayocyanteyatra tu tatpratipāditasādhanābhāvasyaivaśeṣitvaṃ bhavati tatra sādhyatvamaśabdābhihitamapi kalpayitavyamiti viśeṣasiddiḥ| tena kartūtvānvitayo rājasvārājyakāmasyaśeṣitvaṃ rājñastu dravyakarmmasaṃyogaḥ nyāyena sādhānatvānuṃguṇyātaccchaṣatvameva bhavati|
analyzed: tūtīya ādayaḥ tu śeṣa bhāva pratyāsanna sādhanatva abhidhānā tad pramāṇatayā ucyante yatra tu tad pratipādita sādhana abhāvasya eva śeṣi tvam bhavati tatra sādhyatvam aśabda abhihitam api kalpayitavyam iti viśeṣa siddiḥ tena rāja svārājya kāmasya śeṣi tvam rājñaḥ tu dravya karmma saṃyogaḥ nyāyena sādhānatva ānuṃguṇyā tad śaṣatvam eva bhavati

original: yo'pi kaiccinniyojyatvenānvayaḥ phalakāmasyeṣyate so'pi vivicyamānaḥ śeṣitvānvayaevayathokto bhavati| itarathā tu na kartūtvānavayāviśeṣāt| tathā hi|
analyzed: yaḥ api kaiccid niyojya tvena anvayaḥ phala kāmasya iṣyate saḥ api vivicyamānaḥ śeṣi tva anvayaḥ eva yathā uktaḥ bhavati itarathā tu na tathā hi

original: tatkartūtvaniyojyatve śeṣaśeṣitvakārite ||24||
analyzed: tad kartu tva niyojya tve śeṣa śeṣi tva kārite

original: svargakāmasya kartītvānvayaṃ pīrvapakṣīkutya niyojyatvenānvayaḥ siddhāntīkriyataiti yasya darśanaṃ so'pi śeṣaśeṣibhāvavyatirekeṇānvayasya bhedaṃ vaktuaṃ na kṣamate| tathā hi| yo mamedaṃ kāryamiti budhyate sa niyojyaḥ tataśca svargakāmo yajetetyanena svargakāmasyedaṃ kāryamiti pratipādayitavyam| svargakāmakṛtivyāpyamityarthaḥ|
analyzed: svarga kāmasya niyojya tvena anvayaḥ siddhāntīkriyate eti yasya darśanam saḥ api śeṣa śeṣi bhāva vyatirekeṇa anvayasya bhedam na kṣamate tathā hi yaḥ mama idam kāryam iti budhyate sa niyojyaḥ tatas ca svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti anena svarga kāmasya idam kāryam iti pratipādayitavyam svarga kāma kṛti vyāpyam iti arthaḥ

original: hi satyasau mamedaṃ kāryamiti budhyate yacca yasya kṛtyā vyāpyate tatatakartakameva yathā bhāvārthaḥ| tasmādrājasvārājyakāmayoḥ kartṛtvenānvayātsvārājyakāmasya niyojyatvaṃ rājñastu kartṛtvamityayaṃ viśeṣa evaṃ samarthayitavyaḥ| kartṛtve'pi svārājyakāmasya śeṣitvaṃ kāryaṃ prati rājñastu śeṣatvamiti|
analyzed: hi satī asau mama idam kāryam iti budhyate yat ca yasya kṛtyā vyāpyate eva yathā bhāva arthaḥ tasmāt rāja svārājya kāmayoḥ kartṛ tvena anvayāt svārājya kāmasya niyojya tvam rājñaḥ tu kartṛ tvam iti ayam viśeṣaḥ evam samarthayitavyaḥ kartṛ tve pi svārājya kāmasya śeṣi tvam kāryam prati rājñaḥ tu śeṣa tvam iti

original: nanu boddhṛtvena niyojyatvaṃ na śeṣitvena kimidānīṃ kāmaśabdaḥ kāminaḥ kāryaṃ viṣayāvaccchinnaṃ prati boddhṛtvamabhidhate svargakāmaboddhṛkaṃ yāgāvaccchinnaṃ kāryamiti|
analyzed: nanu boddhṛ tvena niyojya tvam na śeṣi tvena kim idānīm kāma śabdaḥ kāminaḥ kāryam viṣaya avacchinnam prati boddhṛ tvam abhidhate svarga kāma boddhṛkam yāga avacchinnam kāryam iti

original: yadyevaṃ boddhṛtvavyatirekeṇa kāminaḥ kakāryānvayābhāvādyajetetyanena yo'rtho'bhihitastameva kevalaṃ budhyeta kāryametaditi na tu mamedaṃ kāryamiti mamaśabdābhidheyasya sambandhasya niyogena sahātmanaḥ kasya cidapyabhāvāt| tataścāniyojyatvameva| na hi yaḥ kāryamiti budhyate sa niyojyaḥ kiṃ tu yo mamedaṃ kāryamiti budhyate| na ca pravṛtiḥ siddhyet|
analyzed: yadi evam boddhṛ tva vyatirekeṇa kāminaḥ ka kārya anvaya abhāvāt yajeta iti anena yaḥ ṛthaḥ abhihitaḥ tam eva kevalam budhyeta kāryam etat iti na tu mama idam kāryam iti mamaśabda abhidheyasya sambandhasya niyogena saha ātmanaḥ kasya cid api abhāvāt tatas ca aniyojya tvam eva na hi yaḥ kāryam iti budhyate sa niyojyaḥ kim tu yaḥ mama idam kāryam iti budhyate na ca pravṛtiḥ siddhyet

original: na hi kāryamityeva kaścitpravartate api tarhi mamedaṃ kāryamiti| anarthakaśca niyojyapratipādakaḥ śabdaḥ syāt antareṇāpi taccchabdamākhyātārthaṃ vyutpannaḥ svargakāmo budhyataeva| tatra parisaṃkhyā syāt| svargakāma eva vyutpanno budhyeta nānya iti sā cāśakyā parisaṃkhyāyamāne'pi vyutpannānāṃ bodhasyānivāryatvāt|
analyzed: na hi kāryam iti eva kaścid pravartate api tarhi mama idam kāryam iti anarthakaḥ ca niyojya pratipādakaḥ śabdaḥ syāt antareṇa api tad śabdam ākhyāta artham vyutpannaḥ svarga kāmaḥ budhyate eva tatra parisaṃkhyā syāt svarga kāmaḥ eva vyutpannaḥ budhyeta na anyaḥ iti sā ca aśakyā parisaṃkhyāyamāne pi vyutpannānām bodhasya anivārya tvāt

original: pitṛyajñādau ca sarveṣāmeva vyutpannānāṃ boddhṛtvalakṣaṇanoyojyatvasadbhāvānna tadadhyāhāraḥ syāt| tasmātsvargakāmasya mamedaṃ kāryamiti evaṃvidhaboddhṛtvalakṣaṇaniyojyatvamiccchatā'vaśyamasyedaṃ  kāryamityevameva vacanena pratipādayitavyamiti vaktavyam| tathā ca kartṛtvenaivānvayaprasaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: pitṛ yajña ādau ca sarveṣām eva vyutpannānām boddhṛ tva lakṣaṇa noyojya tva sadbhāvāt na tad adhyāhāraḥ syāt tasmāt svarga kāmasya mama idam kāryam iti evaṃvidha boddhṛ tva lakṣaṇa niyojya tvam icchatā avaśyam asya idam kāryam iti evam eva vacanena pratipādayitavyam iti vaktavyam tathā ca kartṛ tvena eva anvaya prasaṅgaḥ

original: yadyaucyeta satyamayamevānvayaḥ tathā'pi tu na kartṛtvaniyojyatvasaṅkaraḥ viṣayabhedātkartṛtvaṃ hi
analyzed: yadi aucyeta satyam ayam eva anvayaḥ tathā api tu na kartṛ tva niyojya tva saṅkaraḥ viṣaya bhedāt kartṛ tvam hi

original: bhāvārthe niyoge ca niyojyatvamiti|
analyzed: bhāva arthe niyoge ca niyojya tvam iti

original: tadayuktaṃ na bhāvārthavyatirekeṇa kiṃ cana|
analyzed: tat ayuktam na bhāva artha vyatirekeṇa kim cana

original: kāryaṃ prasiddhamadyāpi niyojyatve sthite hi tat||25||

original: etadadhikaraṇasiddha eva hi niyojyānvayaḥ kriyātiriktakāryābhidhānakalpanābījam| ataḥ prāk na tatsiddhiriti na viṣayabhedādasaṅkaraḥ śakyate'bhidhātum| loke ca tadabhāvāt devadata gāmānayetyādiṣu sambodhanavibhaktisadbhāve'pi devadatādīnāṃ niyojyatvaṃ na syāt| tasmātkāryyaṃ prati śeṣitvameva niyojyatvaṃ ca kartṛtvamityeva vācyam| yastu brūte-
analyzed: etad adhikaraṇa siddhaḥ eva hi niyojya anvayaḥ kriyā atirikta kārya abhidhāna kalpanā bījam atas prāk na tad siddhiḥ iti na viṣaya bhedāt asaṅkaraḥ śakyate abhidhātum loke ca tad abhāvāt devadata gām ānaya ityādiṣu sambodhana vibhakti sadbhāve pi devadata ādīnām niyojya tvam na syāt tasmāt kāryyam prati śeṣi tvam eva niyojya tvam ca kartṛ tvam iti eva vācyam yaḥ tu brūte

original: yadyapi kartṛtvaniyojyatvayoḥ śeṣaśeṣitvabhedādeva viśeṣastathā'pi na niyogaṃ prati niyojyasya śeṣitā tasya sarvapradhānatvāt| yathā''ha "niyogasiddhau sarvaṃ tadaguṇamiti kena neṣyata" iti| kiṃ tarhi kṛtiṃ prati śeṣitvaṃ niyojyatvam|
analyzed: yadi api kartṛ tva niyojya tvayoḥ śeṣa śeṣi tva bhedāt eva viśeṣaḥ tathā api na niyogam prati niyojyasya śeṣi tā tasya sarva pradhāna tvāt yathā āha niyoga siddhau sarvam tat aguṇam iti kena na iṣyate iti kim tarhi kṛtim prati śeṣi tvam niyojya tvam

original: tāṃ ca prati śeṣatvaṃ kartṛtvamiti tenātmārthakṛtivyāpyaṃ kāryaṃ budhyamāno'pi niyojya ityucyate na tu kāryamevātmārthaṃ tena svargakāmo yajetetyasya ko'rthaḥ yāgāvaccchinnaṃ svargakāmārthakṛtivyāpyaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ| tena kāryyaṃ pratyubhayoḥ kartṛniyojyayoḥ śeṣatve satyeva kṛtiṃ prati śeṣaśeṣibhāvādasaṅkara iti| so'pi vṛthaiva kliśyati tathā hi|
analyzed: tām ca prati śeṣa tvam kartṛ tvam iti tena ātma artha kṛti vyāpyam kāryam budhyamānaḥ api niyojyaḥ iti ucyate na tu kāryam eva ātma artham tena svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti asya kaḥ ṛthaḥ yāga avacchinnam svarga kāma artha kṛti vyāpyam kāryam iti arthaḥ tena kāryam prati ubhayoḥ kartṛ niyojyayoḥ śeṣa tve sati eva kṛtim prati śeṣa śeṣi bhāvāt asaṅkaraḥ iti saḥ api vṛthā eva kliśyati tathā hi

analyzed: kṛtiḥ hi kārya śeṣa tvāt na anya śeṣa tvam aśnute

original: kārye taccheṣabhūte'syāstadadvāreṇa bhavedidam||27||

original: na khalu niyogaśeṣabhūtā abhidhānata evāvagamyamānā kṛtiḥ puruṣaśeṣabhāvamanubhavitumarhati| anyārthasyānyārthatā'navakalpanāt| yadi tu tatkāryaṃ puruṣaśeṣo bhavet tatastadadvāreṇa kṛterapi saṃskārāṇāmiva kārakadvāreṇāpūrvaśeṣatā puruṣaśeṣatvaṃ bhavennānyathā|
analyzed: na khalu niyoga śeṣa bhūtā abhidhānataḥ eva avagamyamānā kṛtiḥ puruṣa śeṣa bhāvam anubhavitum arhati anya arthasya anya artha tā anavakalpanāt yadi tu tat kāryam puruṣa śeṣaḥ bhavet tatas tad advāreṇa kṛteḥ api saṃskārāṇām iva kāraka dvāreṇa apūrva śeṣa tā puruṣa śeṣa tvam bhavet na anyathā

original: nanvasatyapi niyogasya puruṣaśeṣatve phalasya taccheṣatvātasyāpi tathaiva kṛtyā vyāpyatvātaddvāreṇa kṛteḥ puruṣaśeṣatā bhaviṣyatīti| kā vārtā naimitikakaniṣedhādhikārayoḥ| na hi tatra phalāntaramasti yaddvāreṇa kṛteḥ puruṣaśeṣatā bhavet| asti ca tatrāpi nimitavānniṣidhyamānakriyāpravṛtaśca niyojyaḥ sa kathamātmārthakṛtivyāpyaṃ kāryaṃ jānīyāt|
analyzed: nanu asati api niyogasya puruṣa śeṣa tve phalasya tad śeṣa tvāt asya api tathā eva kṛtyāḥ vyāpya tvāt tad dvāreṇa kṛteḥ puruṣa śeṣa tā bhaviṣyati iti kā vārtā naimitika ka niṣedha adhikārayoḥ na hi tatra phala antaram asti yad dvāreṇa kṛteḥ puruṣa śeṣa tā bhavet asti ca tatra api nimitavān niṣidhyamāna kriyā pravṛtaḥ ca niyojyaḥ sa katham ātma artha kṛti vyāpyam kāryam jānīyāt

original: tasmānniyogarūpasyāpi kāryasya puruṣārthatvamavaśyamabhyupeyam| yuktaṃ caitat| na hyasvārthaṃ kaścidapi mamedaṃ kāryamityavagantumarhati| yadi naivaṃ phalasyāpi tarhi na puruṣārthatā sidhyet tasyāpi hi mamedaṃ kāryamityetādṛśyevāvagatiḥ| tasmādakāmenāpi kāryameva prati puruṣasya śeṣitvaṃ niyojyatvaṃ śeṣatvaṃ ca kartṛtvamityeva viveko bhaṇitavyaḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt niyoga rūpasya api kāryasya puruṣa artha tvam avaśyam abhyupeyam yuktam ca etat na hi asvārtham kaścid api mama idam kāryam iti avagantum arhati yadi nā evam phalasya api tarhi na puruṣa artha tā sidhyet tasya api hi mama idam kāryam iti etādṛśī eva avagatiḥ tasmāt akāmena api kāryam eva prati puruṣasya śeṣi tvam niyojya tvam śeṣa tvam ca kartṛ tvam iti eva vivekaḥ bhaṇitavyaḥ

original: evaṃ ca sambodhanavibhaktirniyojye pramāṇamityayuktam| agnīdagnīnviharetyādiṣvagnīdādīnāṃ kṛtiṃ vā prati śeṣitvābhāvādaśeṣiṇaścāniyojyatvāt| āha|
analyzed: evam ca sambodhana vibhaktiḥ niyojye pramāṇam iti ayuktam agnīdh agnīn vihara ityādiṣu agnīdh ādīnām kṛtim vā prati śeṣi tva abhāvāt aśeṣiṇaḥ ca aniyojya tvāt āha

original: vidhyarthe kāryarūpe syāccheṣitvena niyojyatā|
analyzed: vidhi arthe kārya rūpe syāt śeṣi tvena niyojya tā

original: pravartakanātmakatve tu pravartyasya niyojyatā||28||
analyzed: pravartaka nātmaka tve tu pravartyasya niyojya tā

analyzed: pravartanā rasaḥ hi aham idam kuryām iti evaṃvidha antar saṃkalpa mūla ātmā avidhiḥ iti bhavatām siddhāntaḥ sa ca pravartyam bhāvyam iva bhāvanā apekṣate pravartyaḥ ca niyojyaḥ tatra svarga kāma śabdaḥ kim bhāvanā apekṣitam bhāvyam samarppayet āho svid vidhi apekṣitam niyojyam ubhaya paratva anupapateḥ vairūpya āpātāt anyatareṇa anyatara siddheḥ

analyzed: svargakāma adhikaraṇe api yāgasya kartavyatā ucyate kāmasya vā iti bhāvya viśeṣa vicāram darśayan siddhānte kāmasya eva bhāvyatā iti darśayati viśvajit adhikaraṇe ca pūrvapakṣe na ca apūrvasya kartavyatām āha phala kartatāyām hi satyām tat avagamyate eti vadan phala bhāvyatā utara kālam apūrva kalpanam darśayati

original: siddhānte'pi phalaviśeṣāpekṣāṃ darśayanna vyāpārasya kartavyatocyate kasya tarhi vyāpāreṇānyasya kasyeti bhavati tadānīṃ sākāṅkṣamityāha| tatkathamiha yajerguṇabhāvaḥ śrūyate| darśapūrṇamāsākhyena yāgasamudāyenānyaṃ kuryāditi yatra kartavyatayā codyate na yajiḥ apūrvaṃ tadityāha| tasmād vyākhyeyametat| kimiti vyākhyātaṃ svayameva bhāṣyakāreṇa|
analyzed: siddhānte api phala viśeṣa apekṣām darśayan na vyāpārasya kartavyatā ucyate kasya tarhi vyāpāreṇa anyasya kasya iti bhavati tadānīm sākāṅkṣam iti āha tat katham iha yajeḥ guṇa bhāvaḥ śrūyate darśa pūrṇamāsa ākhyena yāga samudāyena anyam kuryāt iti yatra kartavyatayā codyate na yajiḥ apūrvam tat iti āha tasmāt vyākhyeyam etat kim iti vyākhyātam svayam eva bhāṣyakāreṇa

original: nanu phalamatra vākye śrūyate svargakāmo yajeteti tatkartavyaṃ syāditi codayitvā satyaṃ śrūyate na tu tadyajinā kriyate vinaṣṭe yajau tadbhavati apūrvantu tena kriyate tasmānna tasya kartavyatocyataiti parihṛtam| asyārthaḥ| na sākṣādyajirviśarārutvātphalaṃ sādhayati kiṃ tu apūrvapraṇālikayā|
analyzed: nanu phalam atra vākye śrūyate svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti tat kartavyam syāt iti codayitvā satyam śrūyate na tu tat yajinā kriyate vinaṣṭe yajau tat bhavati apūrvan tu tena kriyate tasmāt na tasya kartavya tā ucyate eti parihṛtam asya arthaḥ na sākṣāt yajiḥ viśarāru tvāt phalam sādhayati kim tu apūrva praṇālikayā

original: tenāpūrve kṛte tenaiva phalaṃ bhaviṣyatītyavadhāraṇātatsiddhyarthaṃ tatkartavyaṃ bhavati tena bhāvyaprayuktamaṅgajātam| āntarālikabhāvye'pūrve vāṅniyamavadavāntarāpūrve paryavasyatīti etadeva punaścodyapūrvakaṃ prakaṭitam| yaśca yajeḥ pratyakṣaḥ phale guṇabhāvaḥ sa nānāvṛtyā pūrvaṃ saṃbhavatīti prāṇāliko vijñāyataiti|
analyzed: tena apūrve kṛte tena eva phalam bhaviṣyati iti avadhāraṇā tad siddhi artham tat kartavyam bhavati tena bhāvya prayuktam aṅga jātam āntarālika bhāvya ipūrve vāc niyama vat avāntara apūrve paryavasyati iti etat eva punar codya pūrvakam prakaṭitam yaḥ ca yajeḥ pratyakṣaḥ phale guṇa bhāvaḥ sa nānā āvṛtyā pūrvam saṃbhavati iti prāṇālikaḥ vijñāyate eti

original: etena navamādyabhāṣyamapi bhāvapratyayārthe na hītikartavyatā''kāṅkṣayate kartavyaṃ kathamiti na yajiḥ kīdṛśa iti tasmādyatkartavyaṃ tasyetikartavyatayā saṃbandho'pūrvaṃ ca tadityetadvayākhyātaṃ kartavayamiti bhāvyaniṣṭhṃa vyāpāraṃ vidhiyuktaṃ pratyayārthaṃ darśayati|
analyzed: etena navama ādya bhāṣyam api bhāva pratyaya arthe na hi itikartavyatā ākāṅkṣayate kartavyam katham iti na yajiḥ kīdṛśaḥ iti tasmāt yat kartavyam tasya itikartavyatayā ca tat iti etat vayākhyātam kartavayam iti vyāpāram vidhi yuktam pratyaya artham darśayati

original: tasmadyatkartavyamiti yatasya vyāpārasya bhāvyaṃ tadarthamitikartavyatājāmityarthaḥ| apūrvaṃ ca taditi phalasya bhāvyatvaṃ sākṣādaṃsabhavadapūrve saṃkrāntamatastadeva sākṣādbhāvyamityamucyate tato viśvajidadhikaraṇe vyāpāreṇānyasya kartavyatocyate kasyeti bhavati sākāṅkṣaṃtatrādhyāhāro'vakalpataiti na yujyate|
analyzed: tasmat yat kartavyam iti yatasya vyāpārasya bhāvyam tad artham itikartavyatā jām iti arthaḥ apūrvam ca tat iti phalasya bhāvya tvam sākṣāt aṃsabhavat apūrve saṃkrāntam atas tat eva sākṣāt bhāvyam iti amucyate tatas viśvajit adhikaraṇe vyāpāreṇa anyasya kartavya tā ucyate kasya iti bhavati sākāṅkṣam tatra adhyāhāraḥ uvakalpate iti na yujyate

original: yadā hyapūrvākhyasya bhāvyaviśeṣasya svaśabdenaivābhidhānaṃ tadā kasya bhāvyatvamityākāṅkṣā na jāyeta yatra tadviśeṣādhyāhāro bhavet| yadā tu bhāvyaniṣṭho vyāpāraḥ savidhikaḥ kartavyamiti bhāvyaviśeṣāpekṣānimito'dhyāhāraḥ| evamanyatrāpi

original: yāge vā kartavyatocyate kāme veti na tāvadapūrvaṃ kartavyamityuktvā nanu ca phalaṃ kartavyaṃ syādityanena tadevopapādyate nāpūrvasya bhāvyaviśeṣaśabdārthatvam| tasmadevamādyanālocanena pratyayārthatvamapūrvasya bhāṣyakāreṇoktamiti jalpatāmupekṣaivotaramiti|

original: kimarthaṃ punaḥ pratyakṣapratipannabhāvyabhāvaphalaparityāgenānumānikabhāvyabhāvasyāpūrvasya prapojakatvamaṅgīkriyate| etadapi bhāṣyakāreṇaiva phale yajeḥ pratyakṣo guṇabhāvaḥ ānumāniko'pūrvaiti codayitvā pratyakṣo'pi

original: nānādṛtyāpūrvaṃ sambhavatīti prāṇāliko vijñāyate| na caitāvatā pratyakṣaśrutayāgakaraṇatvahāniḥ| yataḥ praṇālyā'pi yena kriyate tatkaraṇaṃ bhavati yathā gomayaiḥ pacanti tuṣapakvā bhavantīti anena parihṛtam| kathamanenaitatparihṛtam| ucyate|

original: etenājyauṣadhasānnāyyadharmmāṇāṃ vāṅniyamādīnāṃ cāvāntarāpūrvaprayuktirvyākhyātā| ataḥ siddhamavātantarāpūrvabhāvanāsambandhād vyavasthitā eva dharmmā na pāriplavā iti| tenānupadiṣṭadharmmakeṣvaindrāgnādiṣvatideśena dharmmāḥ sidhyantītyetatsādhanārthaṃ saptamādikamārabdhavyam|

original: navame tvatidiṣṭānāṃ padārthānāṃ daśamādyasādhyaṃ kāryyaprādhānyaṃ siddaṃ kṛtvā prayogaviśeṣavicāra ūhākhyaḥ kriyate yadyapi cohaśabdastarkamātravacanaḥ tathā'pyasmin śāstre'nyathā'vagatānāṃ padārthānāmanyathābhāvaviṣayo yastarkkaḥ sa ūhaśabdenocyate| yadyapi cātropadeśa eva cintyate| kiṃ prakṛtau hantipiṣiprayuktaṃ prokṣaṇam utāpūrvaprayuktam|

original: pravovājīyāprayuktaṃ prāthamyaprayuktaṃ vā tritvam| savitrādiśabdāḥ samavetābhidhāyino na vā yajñapatiśabdaḥ svārthaḥ parārtho vā| agnisvarūpaprayuktaṃ mantroccāraṇaṃ devatāviśeṣaprayuktaṃ veti|

original: tathā vikṛtāvapyarthāntarāṇāṃ nīvāranakhāvapanaparidhimadhvaśanādīnāṃ pañcadhā prākṛtavrīhyādikāryyāpatirūpadeśārtha eva tathā'pyaṣṭamānantaramevāsya saṅgatiḥ| na hi prakṛtimātrālocane prayuktiviśeṣajijñāsā jāyate kāraṇābhāvāt|

original: yadā tu vikṛtāvatidiṣṭā dharmmāstadā kathamatraite prayoktavyā iti cintā jāyate tadupāyatvena ca kiṃprayuktā ete prakṛtāviti jijñāsā tenopadeśavicāro'pyatidiṣṭeṣveva viśeṣaṃ phalatīti viśeṣātideśānantaramārabdhaḥ| tadupodaghātatayā cāpūrvaprayuktatvaṃsaptamādyasādhitaṃ smāritam|
analyzed: yadā tu vikṛtau atidiṣṭāḥ dharmmāḥ tadā katham atra ete prayoktavyāḥ iti cintā jāyate tad upāya tvena ca kiṃprayuktāḥ ete prakṛtau iti jijñāsā tena upadeśa vicāraḥ upi atidiṣṭeṣu eva viśeṣam phalati iti viśeṣa atideśa anantaram ārabdhaḥ tad upodaghāta tayā ca apūrva prayukta tvam saptama ādi asādhitam smāritam

original: atha vā'traivaitat sādhyate dharmmavyavasthā tu yajiviśeṣaprayuktatve'pyupapadyataityuktam| ūhastu nāpūrvaprayuktatvamantareṇa satā'tratyamapūrvaprayuktatvamuktam| atha vā tatrārādupakāriṇām| iha sannipātināṃ tatprayuktatvamabhidhīyate| tatra tu codyanirākaraṇamātrārthaṃ sannipātiparāmarśaḥ|

original: tadā yena yathopakṛtaṃ tena tathaivopakartavyamiti vikṛtāvapyārādupakārakāṇāṃ paramāpūrvotpatāvadṛṣṭopakārasādhanatvaṃ sannipātināmapi svakārake dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ vā kurvatāṃ yāgasāmarthyajananadvāreṇotpatyapūrvasādhanatvam| mantrāṇāmapi devatādiprakāśanadvāreṇopakārakatvamiti tatsiddhyartham ūhaḥ sannipātināṃ mantrasāmasaṃskārāṇāṃ siddho bhavati|

original: mantrāṇāmapi devatāntaradravyāntaravatyāṃ vikṛtāvavikṛtānāṃ prakṛtivadupakārakatvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti prātipadikaliṅgavacanānāmekaikasya dvayordvayorvā samastānāṃ vā'nyathābhāvātathā'vasthitānāmeva vā'bhyāsādaṣṭadhā'dhikāra ūhaḥ sidhyati| tadūhasyāpi kāryaprādhānyamapekṣitavyamiti dvayorapyūhabādhayossādhāraṇaṃ madhye samārabdhamiti veditavyam|
analyzed: mantrāṇām api devatā antara dravya antaravatyām vikṛtau avikṛtānām prakṛti vat upakāraka tvam na saṃbhavati iti prātipadika liṅga vacanānām ekaikasya dvayoḥ dvayoḥ vā samastānām vā anyathābhāva atathā avasthitānām eva vā abhyāsāt aṣṭadhā adhikāraḥ ūhaḥ sidhyati tad ūhasya api kārya prādhānyam apekṣitavyam iti dvayoḥ api ūha bādhayoḥ sādhāraṇam madhye samārabdham iti veditavyam

original: daśame bādhābhyuccayadvāreṇa vikṛtiṣu padārtheyatā cintyate| kathaṃ punarvacanaprāptasya bādho'dhyavasīyate| yathā  caitatathā vakṣyāmaḥ| prathamaṃ tāvadidaṃ tatsiddhyarthaṃ cintyate kiṃ prākṛtamaṅgajātamanādṛtopakāraṃ svarūpeṇaiva vikṛtāvatidiśyate sauryeṇa kuryāt katham|
analyzed: daśame bādhā abhyuccaya dvāreṇa vikṛtiṣu padārtheyatā cintyate katham punarvacana prāptasya bādhā adhyavasīyate yathā ca etat tathā vakṣyāmaḥ prathamam tāvat idam tad siddhi artham cintyate kim prākṛtam aṅga jātam an ādṛta upakāram svarūpeṇa eva vikṛtau atidiśyate sauryeṇa kuryāt katham

original: āgneyasya savakāryasādhane yaḥ prakāraḥ sa sauryasya syādityatidiśyate tatastaddhayupāyatvenāvāntarāpūrvāṇi prayājādijanyāni prokṣaṇajanyaṃ cādṛṣṭa jātidravyaguṇāvaghātādijanyaṃ ca niyamādṛṣṭānuviddhaṃ dṛṣṭamatidiśyate tatastatsādhanabhūtāḥ padārthā teṣāṃ ca tathāvidhānāmeva pratītyupāyatayā vacanānyatidiśyanta iti|
analyzed: āgneyasya sava kārya sādhane yaḥ prakāraḥ sa sauryasya syāt iti atidiśyate tatas tad hai upāya tvena avāntara apūrvāṇi prayāja ādi janyāni prokṣaṇa janyam ca adṛṣṭa jāti dravya guṇa avaghāta ādi janyam ca niyama adṛṣṭa anuviddham dṛṣṭam atidiśyate tatas tad sādhana bhūtāḥ padārthāḥ teṣām ca tathāvidhānām eva pratīti upāya tayā vacanāni atidiśyante iti

original: tatra pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ prakṛtivatsarvamevāṅgakāṇaḍṃa vikṛterapi vākyaśeṣo bhavati tena teṣu sarveṣu vihiteṣu prakṛtivadyathāsambhavaṃ dṛṣṭamadṛṣṭaṃ vā prayojanaṃ kalpyataiti nāsti bādhaḥ| yadyapi na śāstrātideśaḥ tathā'pi padārthā evātidiśyante nopakāraḥ prakṛtāvupakārasya padārthapūrvakatvādvikṛtāvapi tatpūrvikaiva tasya pratītiḥ|
analyzed: tatra pūrvaḥ pakṣaḥ prakṛti vat sarvam eva vikṛteḥ api vākyaśeṣaḥ bhavati tena teṣu sarveṣu vihiteṣu prakṛti vat yathāsambhavam dṛṣṭam adṛṣṭam vā prayojanam kalpyate eti na asti bādhaḥ yadi api na śāstra atideśaḥ tathā api padārthāḥ eva atidiśyante na upakāraḥ prakṛtau upakārasya padārtha pūrvaka tvāt vikṛtau api tad pūrvikā eva tasya pratītiḥ

original: tatra prathamapratipannapadārthātikrameṇa na yuktaṃ jaghanyapratipanna upakāro'tidiśyataiti| tasmātpadārthānāmeva kāryyanirapekṣāṇāmatidiṣṭānāmihaiva dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaprayojanakalpanānnāsti bādha iti prāpte'bhidhīyate|
analyzed: tatra prathama pratipanna padārtha atikrameṇa na yuktam jaghanya pratipannaḥ upakāraḥ utidiśyate eti tasmāt padārthānām eva kāryya nirapekṣāṇām atidiṣṭānām iha eva dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa prayojana kalpanāt na asti bādhaḥ iti prāptā ibhidhīyate

original: prakārasyātideśaḥ syātpūrvaṃ yasmādapekṣitaḥ|
analyzed: prakārasya atideśaḥ syāt pūrvam yasmāt apekṣitaḥ

original: tato'vāntarakāryāṇāmaṅgānāṃ vacasāṃ kramāt||1||
analyzed: tatas vā antara kāryāṇām aṅgānām vacasām kramāt

original: yadyapi prakṛtāvupakāraḥ śāstrapadārthapūrvaka eva tathā'pi vikṛtāvatideśāvasthāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ śāstrapadārthakāryāṇāṃ klṛptatvāviśeṣe'pi kathaṃbhāvāpekṣā vikṛtibhāvanāprakārameva prathamaṃ svīkaroti na hi tasyāḥ śāstrāṇi padārthā vā svarūpeṇāpekṣitāḥ kiṃ tu prakāraḥ prākṛtaḥ sa eva tāvadaṅgīkriyate sa ca padārthaviśiṣṭāvāntarakāryaviśiṣṭo'tidiṣṭaḥ
analyzed: yadi api prakṛtau upakāraḥ śāstra padārtha pūrvakaḥ eva tathā api vikṛtau atideśa avasthāyām sarveṣām śāstra padārtha kāryāṇām klṛpta tva aviśeṣe pi kathaṃbhāva apekṣā vikṛti bhāvanā prakāram eva prathamam svīkaroti na hi tasyāḥ śāstrāṇi padārthāḥ vā svarūpeṇa apekṣitāḥ kim tu prakāraḥ prākṛtaḥ saḥ eva tāvat aṅgīkriyate sa ca padārtha viśiṣṭa avāntara kārya viśiṣṭa utidiṣṭaḥ

original: san viśeṣaṇāni cārthātprāpayati tena tatsiddhyarthamavāntarakāryāṇi tadarthaṃ cāṅgāni tataḥ śāstrāṇi| yadyapi prathamāvagatāḥ padārthastathaivālocayitavyāstathā'pyanapekṣitatvātpadārthānupekṣya prakārameva cārthātprāpyamāṇeṣu padārtheṣu vrīhīṇāṃ pratyakṣaśrutakṛṣṇalacarau nivṛtau ca taddvārasyāvaghātasya nivṛtiriti
analyzed: san viśeṣaṇāni ca arthāt prāpayati tena tad siddhi artham avāntarakāryāṇi tad artham ca aṅgāni tatas śāstrāṇi yadi api prathama avagatāḥ padārthaḥ tathā eva ālocayitavyāḥ tathā api anapekṣita tvāt padārthān upekṣya prakāram eva ca arthāt prāpyamāṇeṣu padārtheṣu vrīhīṇām pratyakṣa śruta kṛṣṇala carau nivṛtau ca tad dvārasya avaghātasya nivṛtiḥ iti

original: tadatiriktaviśeṣaṇayuktasyaivopakārasyātideśa iti|
analyzed: tad atirikta viśeṣaṇa yuktasya eva upakārasya atideśaḥ iti

original: prakṛtasyopakārasya vikṛtāvupadeśataḥ|
analyzed: prakṛtasya upakārasya vikṛtau upadeśataḥ

original: anvayaṃ kaścidācaṣṭe pitṛyajñe niyojyavat||2||
analyzed: anvayam kaścid ācaṣṭe pitṛ yajñe niyojya vat

original: upadeśo hi granthasandarbhaḥ sa cārthāntarānvitaṃ vidhyarthaṃ kāryatayā pratipādayati| sa tāvatathābhūta eva āṬpadeśikastenāpi yadaparyavasyatā'kṣupyate tadapyaupadeśikameva yathā piṇḍapitṛyajñe niyojyaḥ| yathā ca prakṛtāvupakāraḥ tena vikṛtāvapi vidhyarthakalpitasyopakārasya bhavatyaupakadeśikatvamiti kaścit tanna yuktam|
analyzed: upadeśaḥ hi grantha sandarbhaḥ sa ca artha antara anvitam vidhi artham kāryatayā pratipādayati sa tāva atathābhūtaḥ eva āṭpadeśikaḥ tena api yat aparyavasya tā ākṣupyate tat api aupadeśikam eva yathā piṇḍapitṛyajñe niyojyaḥ yathā ca prakṛtau upakāraḥ tena vikṛtau api vidhi artha kalpitasya upakārasya bhavati aupaka deśika tvam iti kaścid tat na yuktam

original: upakārakabhedātsyādupakāraviśeṣadhīḥ|
analyzed: upakāraka bhedāt syāt upakāra viśeṣa dhīḥ

original: pūrvameva tvapekṣā syātpadārtheṣvapi sā samā||3||
analyzed: pūrvam eva tu apekṣā syāt padārtheṣu api sā samā

original: upakārakapadārthaviśeṣādhīnsiddhirupāpakāraviśeṣo nānavadhāriteṣu teṣu viśeṣarūpeṇa nirūpayituṃ śakyate| bhavitavyaṃ hi kena cidupakāraviśeṣeṇatyapekṣāmātrameva prathamaṃ siddhyati| tacca padārtheṣvapi bhavitavyamupakārajanakaiḥ padārthabhedairityapekṣāsambhavātulyameva|
analyzed: upakāraka padārtha viśeṣa adhīn siddhiḥ upa apakāra viśeṣaḥ na anavadhāriteṣu teṣu viśeṣa rūpeṇa nirūpayitum śakyate bhavitavyam hi kena cid upakāra viśeṣeṇa iti apekṣā mātram eva prathamam siddhi ati tat ca padārtheṣu api bhavitavyam upakāra janakaiḥ padārtha bhedaiḥ iti apekṣā sambhava atulyam eva

original: athocyeta na vidhirviśeṣarūpeṇa padārthānākṣeptuṃ prabhavatīti vākyāntarādibhiratideśena vā yāgadānādipadārthabhedasamarppaṇamapekṣate| upakāraṃ tu viśeṣarūpeṇaivākṣipati| ayameva hi tasya viśeṣākṣepaḥ yadasti kaścidupakāra iti| na hyasau padārthavadayamasāviti nirūpyate tadvidhita eva kalpito'sāvaupadeśikha iti|
analyzed: atha ucyeta na vidhiḥ viśeṣa rūpeṇa padārthān ākṣeptum prabhavati iti vākya antara ādibhiḥ atideśena vā yāga dāna ādi padārtha bheda samarppaṇam apekṣate upakāram tu viśeṣa rūpeṇa eva ākṣipati ayam eva hi tasya viśeṣa ākṣepaḥ yat asti kaścid upakāraḥ iti na hi asau padārtha vat ayam asau iti nirūpyate tad vidhitaḥ eva kalpitā usau aupadeśikhaḥ iti

original: tathā'pi kathaṃ prākṛtasyopakāraviśeṣasyaupadeśikatvaṃ tasya hi nāntareṇa codakaṃ vidhirākṣepāya prabhavati| satyaṃ tathā'pyupakāraviśeṣakalpanāyeśāno'pi lāghavātprākṛtaṃ gṛhṇāti tena kavidhyākṣepasyāpi viśeṣasya niyamamātraṃ codakāditi|
analyzed: tathā api katham prākṛtasya upakāra viśeṣasya aupadeśika tvam tasya hi na antareṇa codakam vidhiḥ ākṣepāya prabhavati satyam tathā api upakāra viśeṣa kalpanāya īśānaḥ api lāghavāt prākṛtam gṛhṇāti tena ka vidhi ākṣepasya api viśeṣasya niyama mātram codakāt iti

original: atrāha| nanu caivaṃ sati dṛṣṭārthānāmavaghātādīnāṃ dravyaguṇādīnāṃ ca vidhita evāniyamenākṣepasaṃbhavādatideśena ca niyamamātrālābhādvrīhyādīnāmapi vikṛtāvupadeśādeva saṃgatiḥ prasajyeta| atha vidhinā yatsākṣādākṣipyate dravyādi na tadaupadeśikamiti paribhāṣyate tathā sati viśvajidyāgasya svargaphalasādhanatvaṃ naupadeśikaṃ syāt|
analyzed: atra āha nanu ca evam sati dṛṣṭa arthānām avaghāta ādīnām dravya guṇa ādīnām ca vidhitaḥ eva aniyamena ākṣepa saṃbhavāt atideśena ca niyama mātra alābhāt vrīhi ādīnām api vikṛtau upadeśāt eva saṃgatiḥ prasajyeta atha vidhinā yat sākṣāt ākṣipyate dravya ādi na tat aupadeśikam iti paribhāṣyate tathā sati viśvajit yāgasya svarga phala sādhanatvam na aupadeśikam syāt

original: vidhiparikalpitaviśiṣṭaniyojyasamabandhakalpitatavāt| tasmānnopakārasyopadeśaḥ sahave tu padārthairupakārasyātideśa eva pramāṇam| tadvadbhāvo hyatideśaḥ| tena yatsākṣātpraṇālyā vā prāpyate tadatideśikaṃ tannirapekṣameva tu granthasaṃdarbhamātreṇa śrutyarthābhyāṃ pramitamāpadeśikamiti vivekaḥ|
analyzed: vidhi parikalpita viśiṣṭa niyojya sama bandha kalpita tavāt tasmāt na upakārasya upadeśaḥ sahave tu padārthaiḥ upakārasya atideśaḥ eva pramāṇam tadvat bhāvaḥ hi atideśaḥ tena yat sākṣāt praṇālyā vā prāpyate tat atideśikam tad nirapekṣam eva tu grantha saṃdarbha mātreṇa śruti arthābhyām pramitam āpadeśikam iti vivekaḥ

original: yadapyucyate upadiṣṭasyāpyupabakārasyānyadīyasyānyatrātideśādatidiṣṭatvamapyasti tenopadeśātideśayorekatraiva yugapatsambhavānnaito pratipakṣabhūtau śabdapramāṇabhedau ata eva nopadeśātideśāśritau ṣaṭkau kiṃ tūpadaśekāryānvitau kāryamiti ca padārthajanyasyopakārasyābhidhānaṃ na niyogasya|
analyzed: yat api ucyate upadiṣṭasya api upabakārasya anyadīyasya anyatra atideśāt atidiṣṭa tvam api asti tena upadeśa atideśayoḥ ekatra eva yugapad sambhavāt na etau pratipakṣa bhūtau śabda pramāṇa bhedau atas eva na upadeśa atideśa āśritau ṣaṭkau kim tu upadaśe kārya anvitau kāryam iti ca padārtha janyasya upakārasya abhidhānam na niyogasya

original: ata evopādānābhidhāno vidhyākṣepaḥ pūrvaṣaṭake cintitaḥ vidhyākṣepyatvādutpatyādīnām| tantrāvāpādi tu prakṛtāvapyupakāraprameyamityutaraṣaṭake nirūpitam| anyathā'tideśaviṣayatve sati
analyzed: atas eva upādāna abhidhānaḥ vidhi ākṣepaḥ pūrva ṣaṭake cintitaḥ vidhi ākṣepya tvāt utpati ādīnām tantra āvāpa ādi tu prakṛtau api upakāra prameyam iti utara ṣaṭake nirūpitam anyathā atideśa viṣaya tve sati

original: prayājādīnāmāgneyādiṣu tantreṇāvṛtyā vā'nuṣṭhānāmityādivicāro nātra saṃbadhyeta tasmānnopadeśātideśāśritaṃ ṣaṭakadvayamapi tūpadeśakāryāśritamiti| tadapyupakārasyoktena nyāyenaupadeśikatvāsambhavānnirastam| tathā hi upadeśātideśāveva pramāṇe tadāśritaṃ ca ṣaṭakadvayaṃ bhavati tathā sati kathamupadiṣṭārthaviṣayā tantrāvāpādicintā|
analyzed: prayāja ādīnām āgneya ādiṣu tantreṇa āvṛtyā vā anuṣṭhānām ityādi vicāraḥ na atra saṃbadhyeta tasmāt na upadeśa atideśa āśritam ṣaṭaka dvayam api tu upadeśa kārya āśritam iti tat api upakārasya uktena nyāyena aupadeśika tva asambhavāt nirastam tathā hi upadeśa atideśau eva pramāṇe tad āśritam ca ṣaṭaka dvayam bhavati tathā sati katham upadiṣṭa artha viṣayā tantra āvāpa ādi cintā

original: anyathā vā kathaṃ saptamāṣṭamayorvacananāmadheyamacodanāliṅgairupakārasyopadeśaprameyasya cintā| sā hi vidhyākṣepaviṣayatvāccātarthikī syāt padārthaprāptisiddhyarthamiti brūmaḥ na hyasatyāmupakārasya prāptau tadvaśena padārthānāṃ prāptirvarṇayituṃ śakyate| tenopodaghātastadvicāraḥ
analyzed: anyathā vā katham saptama aṣṭamayoḥ vacana nāmadheyam acodanā liṅgaiḥ upakārasya upadeśa prameyasya cintā sā hi vidhi ākṣepa viṣaya tvāt cātarthikī syāt padārtha prāpti siddhi artham iti brūmaḥ na hi asatyām upakārasya prāptau tad vaśena padārthānām prāptiḥ varṇayitum śakyate tena upodaghātaḥ tad vicāraḥ

original: pāriplavatvanirākaraṇavaditi| asmatpakṣe'pi prāsaṅgikastantrāvāpādivicāraḥ| daśame hi padārtheyatāyāṃ nirūpitāyāṃ parimāṇaprasaṅgena tantrāvāpaprasaṅgāḥ prayogaparimāṇarūpāścintyante| upadiṣṭātidiṣṭapadārthasādhāraṇyācca ubhayotarakālameva tantrādyārabhyaḥ|
analyzed: pāriplava tva nirākaraṇa vat iti asmad pakṣe api prāsaṅgikaḥ tantra āvāpa ādi vicāraḥ daśame hi padārtha iyatāyām nirūpitāyām parimāṇa prasaṅgena tantra āvāpa prasaṅgāḥ prayoga parimāṇa rūpāḥ cintyante upadiṣṭa atidiṣṭa padārtha sādhāraṇyāt ca ubhaya utara kālam eva tantra ādi ārabhyaḥ

original: yadyapi prayogaviśeṣavicārātmakatvāccaturthapañcamasamīpe'pyārambhasambhavaḥ tathā'pi parimāṇavicārātmakatvādatrāpyārambhaḥ sambhavatīti paryanuyogāviśeṣādatrāpyārambhaḥ yathā bhavanmate kāryapadārthayorupadeśakāryaprameyatvādubhayavicārātmakayossaptamāṣṭamayoranyatarāṃśena caturthotaraṣaṭakāntarbhāvādanyatarakṣārambhe kartavyeka
analyzed: yadi api prayoga viśeṣa vicāra ātmaka tvāt caturtha pañcama samīpe ipi ārambha sambhavaḥ tathā api parimāṇa vicāra ātmaka tvāt atra api ārambhaḥ sambhavati iti paryanuyoga aviśeṣāt atra api ārambhaḥ yathā bhavat mate kārya padārthayoḥ upadeśa kārya prameya tvāt ubhaya vicāra ātmakayoḥ saptama aṣṭamayoḥ anyatara aṃśena caturtha utara ṣaṭaka antarbhāvāt anyatara kṣa ārambhe kartavya ika ārambhe kartavya ika ārambhe kartavya ika ārambhe kartavya ika

original: satyaviśeṣādutaraṣṭaka evārambhaḥ tathā'smākamapi tantrāderiti na doṣaḥ| yaccopakāraprāpteḥ paścātpadārthāṅgīkaraṇaṃ tadapi vyarthaṃ viśiṣṭapakāraprāptyaivārthātpadārthaprāpteḥ| na ceha sāmānyaśāstrātparato viśeṣaśāstrāṇi kalpyante| sarvapadārthasādhāraṇopakāraśāstrataḥ paścānna padārthaviśeṣāṇāṃ śāstrāṇi sambhavantīti|
analyzed: satya viśeṣāt uta raṣṭake eva ārambhaḥ tathā asmākam api tantra ādeḥ iti na doṣaḥ yat ca upakāra prāpteḥ paścāt padārtha aṅgīkaraṇam tat api vyartham viśiṣṭa pakāra prāptyā eva arthāt padārtha prāpteḥ na ca iha sāmānya śāstrāt paratas viśeṣa śāstrāṇi kalpyante sarva padārtha sādhāraṇa upakāra śāstrataḥ paścāt na padārtha viśeṣāṇām śāstrāṇi sambhavanti iti
