original: yadyapyupakārānantaramavāntarakāryāṇi tataḥ padārthāḥ prāpyante tathā'pi teṣāmaśabdatayā mithassambdhābhāvādapūrveṇaiva tādarthyānvayālluptadvārāṇāmapi tatkalpananayā syadevānuṣṭhānam| yadyaucyeta nāvaśyaṃbhāvyupakārasādhanatvamaṅgānāṃ tenopakārasādhanatvaṃ na kalpayitavyamiti| prakṛtau tarhi kathamupakārakalpanā| apekṣitatvāt|
analyzed: yadi api upakāra anantaram avāntara kāryāṇi tatas padārthāḥ prāpyante tathā api teṣām aśabdatayā apūrveṇa eva tādarthya anvayāt lupta dvārāṇām api tad kalpananayā syat eva anuṣṭhānam na avaśyaṃbhāvi upakāra sādhanatvam aṅgānām tena upakāra sādhanatvam na kalpayitavyam iti prakṛtau tarhi katham upakāra kalpanā apekṣita tvāt

original: pradhānasya hyupakārāpekṣā tena prakṛtau śeṣāṇāṃ tajjanakatvaṃ kalpyate| vikṛtau tvaluptārthāṅgajātacanitenaivopakāreṇe pradhānasya nairākāṅkṣyānnāstyupakārakatvaparikalpanaṃ luptārthānāmiti| naitatsāram|
analyzed: pradhānasya hi upakāra apekṣā tena prakṛtau śeṣāṇām tad janaka tvam kalpyate vikṛtau tu alupta artha aṅga jāta canitena eva upakāreṇa pradhānasya nairākāṅkṣyāt na asti upakāraka tva parikalpanam lupta arthānām iti na etat sāram

original: na hyanupakāriṇāmapyaṅgatve satyeva pradhānāpekṣānibandhanaṃ tajjanakatvaparikalpanaṃ trahi labdhaprākṛtopakārāsu vikṛtiṣu tadapekṣābhāvādapūrvāṇāmapi āmanahomādīnāmavaghātādivatajjanakatvaparikalpanāhetvabhāvādanupārakatvena nānuṣṭhānaṃ siddhyet| atha teṣāṃ vacanānarthakyabhayādanuṣṭhānaṃ codakasya tu nānarthakyamaṅgāntareṣvapi kṛtārtha
analyzed: na hi anupakāriṇām api aṅga tve sati eva pradhāna apekṣā nibandhanam tad janakatva parikalpanam labdha prākṛta upakārāsu vikṛtiṣu tad apekṣā bhāvāt apūrvāṇām api āmana homa ādīnām avaghāta ādi vat tad janakatva parikalpanā hetu abhāvāt anupāraka tvena na anuṣṭhānam siddhyet atha teṣām vacana ānarthakya bhayāt anuṣṭhānam codakasya tu na ānarthakyam aṅga antareṣu api kṛtārtha anuṣṭhānam codakasya tu na ānarthakyam aṅga antareṣu api kṛt

original: tvapādityucyate tadayuktam| atrāpyānarthakyāt| na hi sarvapadārthasādhāraṇopakāraprāptyaivārthātpadārthaprāptirabhimatā punarapi śāstreṇaiva padārthānāṃ vidheriṣṭatvāteṣāṃ ca sāmānyarūpābhāvātpratyekamatideśādavaghātasyāpi śāstramananuṣṭhāne'narthakaṃ syāt| atastasyānatideśo vā'nuṣṭhānaṃ vā nānyā gatirasti|
analyzed: tvapāt iti ucyate tat ayuktam atra api ānarthakyāt na hi sarva padārtha sādhāraṇa upakāra prāptyā eva arthāt padārtha prāptiḥ abhimatā punar api śāstreṇa eva padārthānām vidheḥ iṣṭa tvāt eṣām ca sāmānya rūpa abhāvāt pratyekam atideśāt avaghātasya api śāstram ananuṣṭhānena arthakam syāt atas tasya anatideśaḥ vā anuṣṭhānam vā na anyā gatiḥ asti

original: kāmamanarthakaṃ bhavatu naitāvatā'navagato'rthāḥ śakyate kalpayituṃ na hyatra kiṃ cidupakārajanakatve pramāṇamasti| nanvaṅgatvānupapatireva pramāṇaṃ na hyanupakāriṇastadbhavatihantestu prakṛtivadvacanādanyathopakārakatvaṃ na sambhavati| 1tasmādananuṣṭhānamiti cet taduktotaram| prakṛtivadaṅgatvamavaghātasya kṛṣṇaleṣu vidadhadvacanapramāṇaṃ syāditi|
analyzed: kāmam anarthakam bhavatu na etāvatā anavagata ūrthāḥ śakyate kalpayitum na hi atra kim cit upakāra janaka tve pramāṇam asti nanu aṅgatva anupapatiḥ eva pramāṇam na hi anupakāriṇaḥ tad bhavati hanteḥ tu prakṛti vat vacanāt anyathā upakāraka tvam na sambhavati 1tasmāt ananuṣṭhānam iti ced prakṛti vat aṅgatvam avaghātasya kṛṣṇaleṣu vidadhat vacana pramāṇam syāt iti

original: kiṃ ca prāptyabādhe kuśānāmaluptārthānāṃ kimityanuṣṭhānaṃ pratyāmnānāditi cet na| tenāpyaṅgatvānavalopāt tenābādhitāṅgabhāvayoḥ kuśaśarayorvikalpenānuṣṭhānamaikārthyātsyānna bādhaḥ| nanvatulyabalayorupadeśātideśayoḥ kathaṃ vikalpaḥ| kiṃ vopadeśenātideśo bādhyatāmityucyate| omiti cet| na tarhi kuśānāmaṅgatvamasti tatpramāṇasyātideśasya bādhitatvāt|
analyzed: kim ca prāpti abādhe kuśānām alupta arthānām kim iti anuṣṭhānam pratyāmnānāt iti ced na tena api aṅga tva anavalopāt tena ābādhita aṅga bhāvayoḥ kuśa śarayoḥ vikalpena anuṣṭhānam aikārthyāt syāt na bādhaḥ nanu atulya balayoḥ upadeśa atideśayoḥ katham vikalpaḥ kim vā upadeśena atideśaḥ bādhyatām iti ucyate om iti ced na tarhi kuśānām aṅga tvam asti tad pramāṇasya atideśasya bādhita tvāt

original: atha nātideśasya bādho nāpi vikalpaḥ|atha kiṃ samuccayaḥ so'pi na| aikārthyāt| kathaṃ tarhyuktaṃ prayogavacanenānupasaṃgrahādananuṣṭhānamiti| tadeva tu n yuktamaṅgatvābādhāditi brūmaḥ| kaḥ khalvaṅgabhūtayorupakārasādhanayoḥ kuśaśarayorviśeṣaḥ yena dvitīyasyāmiva śareṣu kāpuruṣasya vidheranurāgo bhavet|
analyzed: atha na atideśasya bādhaḥ na api vikalpaḥ atha kim samuccayaḥ saḥ api na aikārthyāt katham tarhi uktam prayoga vacanena anupasaṃgrahāt ananuṣṭhānam iti tat eva tu n yuktam aṅga tva ābādhāt iti brūmaḥ kaḥ khalu aṅga bhūtayoḥ upakāra sādhanayoḥ kuśa śarayoḥ viśeṣaḥ yena dvitīyasyām iva śareṣu kāpuruṣasya vidheḥ anurāgaḥ bhavet

original: ayamasti viśeṣaḥ śarāṇāṃ pratyakṣavacanaṃ pramāṇam itareṣāmanumānamiti|     nāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ pratyakṣeṇāpyanumānasyābādhitatvāt| pramāṇayorhi prābalyābhyāmanyatarasya prameyāpahārānmithyātvaṃ bhavati prameyānapahāre tu dvayorapyarthayoḥ kāryasādhanatvāviśeṣadādaviśiṣṭaṃ kāryanimitamanuṣṭhānamiti|
analyzed: ayam asti viśeṣaḥ śarāṇām pratyakṣa vacanam pramāṇam itareṣām anumānam iti na ayam viśeṣaḥ pratyakṣeṇa api anumānasya abādhita tvāt pramāṇayoḥ hi prābalyābhyām anyatarasya prameya apahārāt mithyātvam bhavati prameya anapahāre tu dvayoḥ api arthayoḥ kārya sādhana tva aviśeṣa dāda viśiṣṭam kārya nimitam anuṣṭhānam iti

original: vidhirhi sādhyabhūtaḥ sādhaneṣvanuṣṭhānamākṣipati sādhanatvaṃ ca dvayorapi
analyzed: vidhiḥ hi sādhya bhūtaḥ sādhaneṣu anuṣṭhānam ākṣipati sādhana tvam ca dvayoḥ api

original: kuśaśarayoraṅgatvāviśeṣād dvārasaṃbhavāccāviśiṣṭamiti nānuṣṭhānākṣepe kaścidviśeṣaḥ| tasmādubhayasyānuṣṭhānānnāstyananuṣṭhānalakṣaṇo bādhaḥ| tathā nārṣeyaṃ vṛṇītaityatra pratiṣedhapakṣe vikalpamabhyupetya tatparihārāya paryudāsa eva codakasyāśritaḥ| yadyaucyate'nārabhya vidheḥ sāmānyarūpasyopadeśātmakasya tatra paryudāso'bhihitaḥ nātideśasyeti|
analyzed: kuśa śarayoḥ aṅga tva aviśeṣāt dvāra saṃbhavāt ca aviśiṣṭam iti na anuṣṭhāna ākṣepe kaścid viśeṣaḥ tasmāt ubhayasya anuṣṭhānāt na asti ananuṣṭhāna lakṣaṇaḥ bādhaḥ tathā na ārṣeyam vṛṇīta eti atra pratiṣedha pakṣe vikalpam abhyupetya tad parihārāya paryudāsaḥ eva codakasya āśritaḥ vidheḥ sāmānya rūpasya upadeśa ātmakasya tatra paryudāsaḥ abhihitaḥ na atideśasya iti

original: kathaṃ tarhi pradeśagrahaṇam| nyāyavirodhādanādaraṇīyamiti cet| aho bata mahāmohasamāśrayaṇaṃ bhavataḥ yadātmīyamajñānamṛṣāvāropayati na hayaṅgatvabādhe satyupadiṣṭamatidiṣṭamityanena kaścidviśeṣaḥ ityuktam|yadi cānapahṛtayorapi prameyayoridaṃ prabalapramidaṃ durbalapramitamityanena viśeṣeṇānuṣṭhānānuṣṭhānānanuṣṭhāne bhavataḥ tato
analyzed: katham tarhi pradeśa grahaṇam nyāya virodhāt anādaraṇīyam iti ced aho bata mahā moha samāśrayaṇam bhavataḥ yat ātmīyam ajñānam ṛṣau āropayati na hayaṅga tva bādhe sati upadiṣṭam atidiṣṭam iti anena kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti uktam yadi ca anapahṛtayoḥ api prameyayoḥ idam durbala pramitam iti anena viśeṣeṇa anuṣṭhāna anuṣṭhāna ananuṣṭhāne bhavataḥ tatas

original: dūrādvahnimadhyakṣayannārāccānumimāno'numitaṃ hitvā pākārthī durasthamupadhāvet|tathā yajatiṣu yeyajāmahaṃ karotītyasya sāmānyavidhernānuyājeṣu yeyajāmahaṃ karotītyato viśeṣapratiṣedhādāhavanīyaśāstrasyeva viśeṣaśāstrātpadavidhāyino durbalatvātpratiṣethe satyapyananuṣṭhānaṃ yeyajāmahasyānuyājeṣu śakyate vaktumityanarthakaṃ paryudāsapratipādanaṃ
analyzed: dūrāt vahnim adhyakṣayat nārāt ca anumimānaḥ anumitam hitvā pāka arthī durastham upadhāvet tathā yajatiṣu yeyajāmaham karoti ityasya sāmānya vidheḥ na anuyājeṣu yeyajāmaham karoti iti atas viśeṣa pratiṣedhāt āhavanīya śāstrasya iva viśeṣa śāstrāt pada vidhāyinaḥ durbala tvāt pratiṣethe sati api ananuṣṭhānam yeyajāmahasya anuyājeṣu śakyate vaktum iti anarthakam paryudāsa pratipādanam

original: syāt|tasmānna kathaṃ cidapi prāptyabādhe satyananuṣṭhānaṃ saṃbhavatīti prāptireva bādhayitavyā| yatvevaṃ sati prāptabādhābhidhānamanupapannaṃ tārtīyadāśamikayoraviśeṣāditi|atrābhidhīyate|
analyzed: syāt tasmāt na katham cit api prāpti abādhe sati ananuṣṭhānam saṃbhavati iti prāptiḥ eva bādhayitavyā yatu evam sati prāpta bādhā abhidhānam anupapannam tārtīya dāśamikayoḥ aviśeṣāt iti atra abhidhīyate

original: sādhāraṇasya śāstrasya viśeṣāviṣayādinā|
analyzed: sādhāraṇasya śāstrasya viśeṣa aviṣaya ādinā

original: kalpyasya śāstrasya tu kalpanaṃ yannirudhyate mūlanikṛntatena|
analyzed: kalpyasya śāstrasya tu kalpanam yat nirudhyate

original: klṛptena śīghreṇa phalāpahārādaprāptabādhaṃ tamudāhanti||15||
analyzed: klṛptena śīghreṇa phala apahārāt aprāpta bādham tam udāhanti

original: yatra klṛptasyaiva śāstrasya sāmānyadvāreṇa viśeṣānupasarpataḥ kva cidviśeṣayāgā1dinā prāptirapodyate tatra prāptabādhaḥ| yathā prākṛtavaikṛtasāmānyaviśeṣanityanaimitikakratvarthapuruṣārthapaurvāparyālpabhūyastvasāvakāvakāśāhaṅgapradhānataddharmmabādheṣu| prākṛtā
analyzed: yatra klṛptasya eva śāstrasya sāmānya dvāreṇa viśeṣān upasarpataḥ kva cit viśeṣa yāga ādinā prāptiḥ apodyate tatra prāpta bādhaḥ yathā prākṛta vaikṛta sāmānya viśeṣa nitya naimitika kratu artha puruṣa artha paurvāparya alpa bhūyastva sāvaka avakāśa ahaṅga pradhāna tad dharmma bādheṣu prākṛtāḥ

original: hi dharmmā na prātisvikena rūpeṇa codakena vikṛtau prāpyante idamidaṃ kartavyamiti| kathaṃ tarhi yathā prakṛtyā svakāryaṃ sādhitaṃ tathā vikṛtyā'pīti| tathābhāvaśca taireva padārthaistathā saṃbadhyamānaiḥ saṃpādayituṃ śakyate nānyatheti| teṣāṃ tatsādhantvasāmānyarūpeṇa prāptiraviśeṣeṇ pratīyate|
analyzed: hi dharmmāḥ na prātisvikena rūpeṇa ca udakena vikṛtau prāpyante idam idam kartavyam iti katham tarhi yathā prakṛtyā sva kāryam sādhitam tathā vikṛtyā api iti tathābhāvaḥ ca taiḥ eva padārthaiḥ tathā saṃbadhyamānaiḥ saṃpādayitum śakyate na anyathā iti teṣām tad sādhantva sāmānya rūpeṇa prāptiḥ aviśeṣeṇa pratīyate

original: seyaṃ pratītiraviśeṣeṇopajātā satī paścātatatpadārthaviśeṣanirūpaṇāvasare hantyādestathā sādhanabhāvāsambhavaparyālocanena bhrāntīkriyate| na caitāvatā śāstrasyāprāmāṇyaṃ tasya viṣayaviśeṣapariśeṣamātraparikalpanāt|
analyzed: sā iyam pratītiḥ aviśeṣeṇa upajātā satī paścāta tad padārtha viśeṣa nirūpaṇa avasare hanti ādeḥ tathā sādhana bhāva asambhava paryālocanena bhrāntīkriyate na ca etāvatā śāstrasya aprāmāṇyam tasya viṣaya viśeṣa pariśeṣa mātra parikalpanāt

original: viśeṣādarśanen hi sāmānyamātrālocanātsarvaviṣayatvaṃ śāstrasyāprāmāṇyaṃ tasya viṣayaviśeṣapariṣamātraparikalpanāt|viśeṣādarśanena hi sāmānyamātrālocanātsarvaviṣayatvaṃ śāstrasya bhrāntyā'vagamyate|
analyzed: viśeṣa adarśanena hi sāmānya mātra ālocanāt sarva viṣaya tvam śāstrasya aprāmāṇyam tasya viṣaya viśeṣa pariṣa mātra parikalpanāt viśeṣa adarśanena hi sāmānya mātra ālocanāt sarva viṣaya tvam śāstrasya bhrāntyā avagamyate

original: taddarśanātu nāyamasya viṣayo'nyaviṣayameva tu śāstraṃ sāmānyamātraparyālocanādoṣādetadviṣayatven bhrāntyā'dhyavasitamiti manyate tenārthalopātpratyāmnānātpratiṣedhācca kacodakasaṃkocaḥ| tathā āhavanīyavidhāyinaḥ sāmānyaśāstrasya padavidhāyinā viśeṣāśāstreṇa homāntaraviṣayatvakalpanam| pāñcadaśyasya
analyzed: tad darśanāt tu na ayam asya viṣayaḥ nya viṣayam eva tu śāstram sāmānya mātra paryālocanā doṣāt bhrāntyā adhyavasitam iti manyate tena artha lopāt pratyāmnānāt pratiṣedhāt ca kaca udaka saṃkocaḥ tathā āhavanīya vidhāyinaḥ sāmānya śāstrasya pada vidhāyinā viśeṣa aśāstreṇa homa antara viṣaya tva kalpanam pāñcadaśyasya

original: nityasyāviśeṣavihitasya nityasyāviśeṣavihitasya vaiśyaviṣayeṇa naimitikena sāptadaśyen varṇāntaraviṣayatvam| sāptadaśyasyāpi kratvarthasya puruṣārthenaikaviṃśādyanuvacanena pratiṣṭhākāmavyatiriktavaiśyaviṣayatvam| kana cātra sāmānyaviśeṣabhāva ubhayorapi sāmānyatvāt|
analyzed: nityasya a viśeṣa vihitasya nityasya a viśeṣa vihitasya vaiśya viṣayeṇa naimitikena sāptadaśyen varṇa antara viṣaya tvam sāptadaśyasya api kratu arthasya puruṣa arthena ekaviṃśa ādi anuvacanena pratiṣṭhā kāma vyatirikta vaiśya viṣaya tvam ca atra sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvaḥ ubhayoḥ api sāmānya tvāt

original: ekaviṃśatyanuvacanaṃ hi pratiṣṭhākāmavarṇatrayasādhāraṇaṃ sāptadaśyamapi pratiṣṭhākāmātatkāmavaiśyasādhāraṇaṃ pratiṣṭhākāme tu vaiśyedvayossannipāte sati puruṣārthānuvacanena kratvarthasya pratyāsannaphalenānyādṛśasya bādhaḥ| tathā paurvāparye'pi codnātṛpratihartrapacchedayoḥ sāmānyaviśeṣabhedābhāvātpaurvāparyyavaśādeva mitho bādhaḥ|
analyzed: ekaviṃśati anuvacanam hi pratiṣṭhā kāma varṇa traya sādhāraṇam sāptadaśyam api pratiṣṭhā kāma a tad kāma vaiśya sādhāraṇam pratiṣṭhā kāme tu vaiśya idvayoḥ sannipāte sati puruṣa artha anuvacanena kratu arthasya pratyāsanna phalena anyādṛśasya bādhaḥ tathā paurvāparye api ca udnātṛ pratihartṛ apacchedayoḥ sāmānya viśeṣa bheda abhāvāt paurvāparya vaśāt eva mithas bādhaḥ

original: tatraivaṃ śāstrārtho bhavati paścādbhāvyudgātrapacchedavidhurapratihartrapacchedavataḥ kratoḥ sarvavedasadānamaṅgamiti evamudgātrapacchede'pi draṣṭavyam| tathā pañcaśarātre prathame'hanyāgniṣṭuannāmadheye ekāhāgniṣṭuaddharmmeṣu prāpteṣu subrahmaṇyā'gneyī prāptā utareṣāṃ caturdaśānāmanhāmaindrī tatrālpavaiguṇyenāpi gatau satyāṃ bādhyate|
analyzed: tatra evam śāstra arthaḥ bhavati paścāt bhāvi udgātṛ apaccheda vidhura pratihartṛ apacchedavataḥ kratoḥ sarvavedasa dānam aṅgam iti evam udgātṛ apacchede api draṣṭavyam tathā pañcaśarātre prathamehanyā agniṣṭuat nāmadheye ekāha agniṣṭuat dharmmeṣu prāpteṣu subrahmaṇyā āgneyī prāptā utareṣām caturdaśānām anhām aindrī tatra alpa vaiguṇyena api gatau satyām bādhyate

original: tenāgniṣṭuannāmadheyaṃ subrahmaṇyāgneyīvyatiriktātideśaparaṃ bhavati| tathā yaktiṃ citprācīnamagnīṣomīyātenopāṃśu carantītyasya yāvatyā vācā kāmayeta tāvatyā vācā dīkṣaṇīyāyāmanubrūyādityanen dīkṣaṇīyādipradhāneṣu svarāntaravidhānādanyaviṣayatvam| na cāsya sāmānyatmatā yaktiṃciccchabdasya prakṛtaviśeṣābhidhāyitvāt |
analyzed: tena agniṣṭut nāmadheyam subrahmaṇya āgneyī vyatirikta atideśa param bhavati tathā yaktim cit prācīnam agnīṣomīyā tena upāṃśu caranti iti asya yāvatyā vācā kāmayeta tāvatyā vācā dīkṣaṇīyāyām anubrūyāt iti anen dīkṣaṇīya ādi pradhāneṣu svara antara vidhānāt anya viṣaya tvam na ca asya sāmānya tma tā yaktiṃcit śabdasya prakṛta viśeṣa abhidhāyi tvāt

original: tena sāvakāśaniravakāśatvenātra bādhaḥ| tathopāṃśu yajuṣeti vihitaṃ yajurahgamupāṃśutvaṃ nigadeṣu pradhānabhūtaparapratyāyanakāryavirodhādbādhyate tena yajuḥṣūpāṃśutvavidhānaṃ nigadavyatiriktayajurviṣayaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: tena sa avakāśa niravakāśa tvena atra bādhaḥ tathā upāṃśu yajuṣā iti vihitam yajuḥ ahgam upāṃśu tvam nigadeṣu pradhāna bhūta para pratyāyana kārya virodhāt bādhyate tena yajuḥṣu upāṃśu tva vidhānam nigada vyatirikta yajuḥ viṣayam bhavati

original: tathā ya iṣṭaḷa paśunā somena vā yajeta so'māvāsyāyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ vetyaneneṣṭiṣu paśau some ca parvaṇi prāpte satyekādidīkṣāpakṣe sutyādīkṣaṇīyayorubhayorapi parvasaṃpādanāsaṃbhavādanyatarasya bādhe kartavye sati pradhānasyāvaiguṇyāddīkṣaṇīyāyāṃ parvabādhaḥ teneṣṭiṣu parvavidhānaṃ pradhānekālāvirodhiviṣayaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: tathā yaḥ paśunā somena vā yajeta somāvāsyāyām paurṇamāsyām vā iti anena iṣṭiṣu paśau some ca parvaṇi prāpte sati eka ādi dīkṣā pakṣe sutyā dīkṣaṇīyayoḥ ubhayoḥ api parva saṃpādana asaṃbhavāt anyatarasya bādhe kartavye sati pradhānasya avaiguṇyāt dīkṣaṇīyāyām parva bādhaḥ tena iṣṭiṣu parva vidhānam pradhāna ikāla avirodhi viṣayam bhavati

original: tadevaṃ sarvatra kalpanābhimukhasya śīghreṇa tadviṣayāpahārātkalpanāmūlaṃ nikṛtya tannirodhaḥ kriyate tatrāprāptabādho yathā śrutiliṅgādiṣu|
analyzed: tat evam sarvatra kalpanā abhimukhasya śīghreṇa tad viṣaya apahārāt kalpanā mūlam nikṛtya tad nirodhaḥ kriyate tatra aprāpta bādhaḥ yathā śruti liṅga ādiṣu

original: na hyaṬndraḷendramupatiṣṭhataiti śāstramasti yasya prāptasyaindraḷa gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhataityanena bādhaḥ syānna hi liṅgamātraṃ svata eva pramāṇaṃ tatkalpitā tu śrutiratra pramāṇaṃ tatkalyanāyāmapi na tanmātraṃ pramāṇaṃ kiṃ tu|
analyzed: na hi a ṭa indram upatiṣṭhate iti śāstram asti yasya prāptasya aindraḥ gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate iti anena bādhaḥ syāt na hi liṅga mātram svatas eva pramāṇam tad kalpitā tu śrutiḥ atra pramāṇam tad kalyanāyām api na tad mātram pramāṇam kim tu

original: mantrākāṅkṣāsanāthaṃ tatpramāṇaṃ śrutikalpane|
analyzed: mantra ākāṅkṣā sanātham tat pramāṇam śruti kalpane

original: tāṃ cānyatra niyogena pratyakṣā kṛntati śrutiḥ||16||
analyzed: tām ca anyatra niyogena pratyakṣā kṛntati śrutiḥ

original: tena pratyakṣeṇa śāstreṇa sākāṅkṣamantraliṅgakalpyaśrutiviṣayaṃ mantramapahṛtya gārhapatyopasthāne viniyujya mantraṃ nirākāṅkṣīkurvatā kalpanāmūlabhūtā''kāṅkṣā nirākṛteti na tadadhīnātmalābhāśrutirunmajjituṃ kṣamate| evamanyatrāpyaprāptabādho draṣṭavyaḥ| tadupapannaḥ|
analyzed: tena pratyakṣeṇa śāstreṇa sākāṅkṣa mantra liṅga kalpya śruti viṣayam mantram apahṛtya gārhapatya upasthāne viniyujya mantram nirākāṅkṣīkurvatā kalpanā mūla bhūta ākāṅkṣā nirākṛtā iti na tad adhīna ātmalābhā śrutiḥ unmajjitum kṣamate evam anyatra api aprāpta bādhaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ tad upapannaḥ

original: na hi tasya kiṃ citprāptaṃ bādhyate na tatprāptamiti na prāptabādhasaṃbhavastakasmādyathoktameva nyāyyam| yatu kṛtsraprāpī codako na kiṃ cidvarjayitumarhatīti|
analyzed: na hi tasya kim cit prāptam bādhyate na tat prāptam iti na prāpta bādha saṃbhavaḥ takasmāt yathā uktam eva nyāyyam yatu kṛtsra prāpī codakaḥ na kim cit varjayitum arhati iti

original: satyamayamevāsya svabhāvaḥ  sa tu svabhāvaḥ prabalena hetunā pratibadhyate sāmānyaśāstrasyeva viśeṣaśāstreṇa tadvarjantu vacanaprāpterna codakārthakārsnyādityapi svabhāvata eva katipayaviṣayatvamāśaṅkya nirākṛtamiti veditavyam| yadyapi cātra na kāraṇadoṣeṇa mithyātvaṃ
analyzed: satyam ayam eva asya svabhāvaḥ sa tu svabhāvaḥ prabalena hetunā pratibadhyate sāmānya śāstrasya iva viśeṣa śāstreṇa tat varjan tu vacana prāpteḥ na codaka artha kārsnyāt iti api svabhāvataḥ eva katipaya viṣaya tvam āśaṅkya nirākṛtam iti veditavyam yadi api ca atra na kāraṇa doṣeṇa mithyātvam

original: sāmānyaśāstrajñānasyopalakṣayituṃ śakyate tathā'pi bādhakena pratyayāntareṇa tadupalakṣaṇaṃ bhavati dvayamapi hi tadupalakṣaṇatvenoktaṃ "yasya ca duṣṭaṃ karaṇaṃ yatra ca mithyeti pratyayaḥ so'samīcīnaḥ pratyayaḥ" iti| tatra vaidikeṣu sambhavāt bādhakapratyaya eva tadupalakṣaṇaṃ na karaṇadoṣajñānamasambhavāt| āha ca|
analyzed: sāmānya śāstra jñānasya upalakṣayitum śakyate tathā api bādhakena pratyaya antareṇa tat upalakṣaṇam bhavati dvayam api hi tad upalakṣaṇa tvena uktam yasya ca duṣṭam karaṇam yatra ca mithyā iti pratyayaḥ saḥ usamīcīnaḥ pratyayaḥ iti tatra vaidikeṣu sambhavāt bādhaka pratyayaḥ eva tat upalakṣaṇam na karaṇa doṣa jñānam asambhavāt āha ca

original: "yatu kāraṇadoṣajñānaṃ dvitīyamupalakṣaṇamuktaṃ tallokaviṣaytavānna vede sambhavatīti nopanyastami"ti| kathaṃ punaraduṣṭena karaṇena mithyājñānaṃ janyate na hi bādhekana mithyājñānaṃ jāyate jātasya tu
analyzed: yatu kāraṇa doṣa jñānam dvitīyam upalakṣaṇam uktam tat loka viṣaytavān na vede sambhavati iti na upanyastam iti katham punar aduṣṭena karaṇena mithyājñānam janyate na hi mithyājñānam jāyate jātasya tu

original: mithyāsatastatvamasau jñāpayati| tajjanmatu kāraṇadoṣādeva| satyameva tat| atrāpi hi kāraṇadoṣo vidyataeva yadyapyasāvapauruṣeyasya vedasya na svagataḥ kaściddoṣo vidyate tathā'pi pratipatureva sāmānyāpahṛtabuddhitvādapavādānirūpaṇācca nyāyābhāsebhyaḥ prasaranmithyājñānaṃ jāyate|
analyzed: mithyā sataḥ tatvam asau jñāpayati tad janma tu kāraṇa doṣāt eva satyam eva tat atra api hi kāraṇa doṣaḥ vidyate eva yadi api asau apauruṣeyasya vedasya na svagataḥ kaścid doṣaḥ vidyate tathā api pratipatuḥ eva sāmānya apahṛta buddhi tvāt apavāda anirūpaṇāt ca nyāya ābhāsebhyaḥ prasarat mithyājñānam jāyate

original: ata eva samyak nyāyanirūpaṇārthaṃ mīmāṃsāśāstramarthavadbhavati na cāyaṃ doṣo bādhākātprāgaṅgulyavaṣṭambhādiva nirūpayituṃ śakyataiti bādhakaikopalakṣaṇīyatvaṃ mithyātvasyābhihitamiti sarvavadātam| tatsiddhaṃ yadevamidamiti niścitaṃ jñānaṃ kāraṇāntareṇe mithyeti kathyate nāsti luptārthānāṃ codakavacanam|
analyzed: atas eva samyak nyāya nirūpaṇa artham mīmāṃsā śāstram arthavat bhavati na ca ayam doṣaḥ bādhākāt prāk aṅguli avaṣṭambhāt iva nirūpayitum śakyate eti bādhaka eka upalakṣaṇīya tvam mithyātvasya abhihitam iti sarvavadātam tat siddham yat evam idam iti niścitam jñānam mithyā iti kathyate na asti lupta arthānām codaka vacanam

original: luptāprākṛtaprayojanaṃ na codakaścodayatītyādibhāṣyāvināśāt| api tu vākyaśeṣaḥ syāditi ca sūtrāvināśālluptārthapratyāmnātapratiṣiddhebhyo'ṅgebhyaścodakasya samutkālanam|
analyzed: lupta aprākṛta prayojanam na codakaḥ codayati ityādi bhāṣya avināśāt api tu vākyaśeṣaḥ syāt iti ca sūtra avināśāt lupta artha pratyāmnāta pratiṣiddhebhyaḥ ṛṅgebhyaḥ codakasya samutkālanam

original: kṛṣṇalādiṣu hantyāderanaṅgatvaṃ tathā kriyā|
analyzed: kṛṣṇala ādiṣu hanti ādeḥ anaṅga tvam tathā kriyā

original: niyamādṛṣṭasiddhistu niyamānna svarūpataḥ||17||
analyzed: niyama adṛṣṭa siddhiḥ tu niyamāt na svarūpataḥ

original: tatraitatsyāt|yadyapi kṛṣṇaleṣu hantirddaṣṭārthaṃ na prāpyate tathā'pi niyamādṛṣṭasiddhyarthaṃ kinna prāpyataiti| tanna| tatra katasyāsambhavāt| evaṃ hi tatkalpyate avaghātenaiva niṣpādyamānāstaṇḍulā apūrvaṃ sādhayantīti na taivamiha sambhavatīti| aprayojakatvācca|
analyzed: tatra etat syāt yadi api kṛṣṇaleṣu hantiḥ ddaṣṭa artham na prāpyate tathā api niyama adṛṣṭa siddhi artham kim na prāpyate eti tat na tatra katasya asambhavāt evam hi tat kalpyate avaghātena eva niṣpādyamānāḥ taṇḍulāḥ apūrvam sādhayanti iti na tā evam iha sambhavati iti aprayojaka tvāt ca

original: na hyavaghātasya niyamādṛṣṭaṃ  prayojakaṃ dṛṣṭaproyajanenaiva tāvatsvarūpe prāpte niyamamātraṃ tena prayujyate| tena yadyapi caruṣu peṣaṇamapratiṣiddhaṃ piṣṭasyāpi catutvāvighātāt tathā'pi prayojanabhāvātpeṣaṇasvarūpasyāprāptestadadhīnatvācca niyamaprayukterananuṣṭhānam| satyapi ca prayojane prayojakābhāvātpuroḍāśakapālādeścarvādiṣu bādha iti|
analyzed: na hi avaghātasya niyama adṛṣṭam prayojakam dṛṣṭa proyajanena eva tāvat sva rūpe prāpte niyama mātram tena prayujyate tena yadi api caruṣu peṣaṇam apratiṣiddham piṣṭasya api catutva avighātāt tathā api prayojana bhāvāt peṣaṇa sva rūpasya aprāpteḥ tad adhīna tvāt ca niyama prayukteḥ ananuṣṭhānam sati api ca prayojane prayojaka abhāvāt puroḍāśa kapāla ādeḥ caru ādiṣu bādhaḥ iti

original: etena citreṣṭaḷaṃ taṇḍuleṣu prākṛtasya vrīhiyavaprakṛtidravyaniyamasya bādho vyākhyātaḥ| tathā hi|
analyzed: etena taṇḍuleṣu prākṛtasya vrīhi yava prakṛti dravya niyamasya bādhaḥ vyākhyātaḥ tathā hi

original: prāpte prakṛtyupādāne niyamo'tra vidhīyate|
analyzed: prāpte prakṛti upādāne niyamaḥ utra vidhīyate

original: lokikā eva tu grāhyāstaṇḍulāḥ prakṛtirna tu||18||
analyzed: lokikāḥ eva tu grāhyāḥ taṇḍulāḥ prakṛtiḥ na tu

original: na hi prakṛtau vraheyeṇa haviṣā yajeteti śāstramasti yadatideśātaṇḍulānāmapi tanmayatvaṃ syāt|yāgaṃ prati vrīhibhiryajeteti vrīhīṇāṃ karaṇatvaṃ śrūyate kartṛvyāpāragocaraśca karaṇaṃ bhavati| yathā''huḥ|
analyzed: na hi prakṛtau vraheyeṇa haviṣā yajeta iti śāstram asti yat atideśāt taṇḍulānām api tad maya tvam syāt yāgam prati vrīhibhiḥ yajeta iti vrīhīṇām karaṇa tvam śrūyate kartṛ vyāpāra gocaraḥ ca karaṇam bhavati yathā āhuḥ

original: "karaṇaṃ khalu sarvatra kartṛvyāpāragocara" iti|
analyzed: karaṇam khalu sarvatra kartṛ vyāpāra gocaraḥ iti

original: tena vrīhīnupādāyatairyaṣṭavyamiti| karaṇatvaṃ ca teṣāmutpatiśiṣṭapuroḍāśāvaruddhe yāge tatprakṛtitvena sambhavatītyeṣa śāstrārtho vrīhīnupādāya tairhaviḥ saṃpādya yajeteti| atra ca haviḥ saṃpādya yajetetyanūdya vrīhibhirityetāvanmātraṃ vidhīyate| evaṃ ca satyārthikaṃ haviṣasatanmayatvaṃ na śrautam| na caivaṃ taṇḍuleṣu
analyzed: tena vrīhīn upādāya taiḥ yaṣṭavyam iti karaṇa tvam ca teṣām utpati śiṣṭa puroḍāśa avaruddhe yāge tad prakṛti tvena sambhavati iti eṣa śāstra arthaḥ vrīhīn upādāya taiḥ haviḥ saṃpādya yajeta iti atra ca haviḥ saṃpādya yajeta iti anūdya vrīhibhiḥ iti etāvat mātram vidhīyate evam ca satya ārthikam haviṣa sa tad maya tvam na śrautam na ca evam taṇḍuleṣu

original: saṃbhavati na hi tatra prakṛtyupādānena havissaṃpādanīyaṃ prāptaṃ yat vrīhibhiriti niyamyeta lokasiddhāneva taṇḍulānupādāya yaṣṭuaṃ śakyatvāt| nanu prakṛtāvapi lokikameva puroḍāśamādāya yāgasya kartuṃ śakyatvātkathaṃ prakṛtyupādānena havissaṃpādanaprāptiriti cet| taducyate|
analyzed: saṃbhavati na hi tatra prakṛti upādānena haviḥ saṃpādanīyam prāptam yat vrīhibhiḥ iti niyamyeta loka siddhān eva taṇḍulān upādāya śakya tvāt nanu prakṛtau api lokikam eva puroḍāśam ādāya yāgasya kartum śakya tvāt katham prakṛti upādānena haviḥ saṃpādana prāptiḥ iti ced tat ucyate

original: haviḥ śrapaṇasādhyaṃ hi puroḍāśākhyamiṣyate|
analyzed: haviḥ śrapaṇa sādhyam hi puroḍāśa ākhyam iṣyate

original: svayaṃkartṛkatā tasya śrapaṇasya vidhīyate||19||
analyzed: svayaṃkartṛkatā tasya śrapaṇasya vidhīyate

original: puroḍāśarūpaṃ hi havirnāntareṇa śrapaṇaṃ sidhyati tatkiṃlaukikamevopādeyaṃ svayameva vā prakṛtyupādānena saṃpādayitavyamiti yadyapyutpativākyādaniyamaḥ prāptaḥ aṣṭākapālena yajetetyasyobhayathā'pyupapatestathā'pi kapāleṣu śrapayatīti vacanānnānyena śrapitaṃ gṛhṇātīti svayaṃkartṛkatvameva tvasya vidheyaṃ sarvamanyadutpativākyasāmarthyasiddham|
analyzed: puroḍāśa rūpam hi haviḥ na antareṇa śrapaṇam sidhyati tat kiṃlaukikam eva upādeyam svayam eva vā prakṛti upādānena saṃpādayitavyam iti yadi api utpati vākyāt aniyamaḥ prāptaḥ aṣṭākapālena yajeta iti asya ubhayathā api upapateḥ tathā api kapāleṣu śrapayati iti vacanāt na anyena śrapitam gṛhṇāti iti svayam kartṛka tvam eva tvasya vidheyam sarvam anyat utpati vākya sāmarthya siddham

original: kapālānyutpativākyasiddhāni śrapaṇamapi sāmarthyānnāśrapitasya puroḍāśatvamastīti śrapitadravyaviśeṣanatvātpuroḍāśacarvādiśabdānām| tataḥ svayaṃkartṛkataivātra vidheyā| yathā''habhagavān bhāṣyakāraḥ|
analyzed: kapālāni utpati vākya siddhāni śrapaṇam api sāmarthyāt na a śrapitasya puroḍāśa tvam asti iti śrapita dravya viśeṣana tvāt puroḍāśa caru ādi śabdānām tatas svayam kartṛka tā eva atra vidheyā yathā āha bhagavān bhāṣyakāraḥ

original: "kapāleṣu śrapayatīti vacanānnānyena śrapitaṃ gṛhṇātīti tadbalena prakṛtyupādānaṃ prāpnoti"ti na hyanyathā svayaṃ śrapayituṃ śakyate evaṃ prakṛtidravyopādāne prāpte kimavasthaṃ kiṃrūpaṃ ca dravyamupādeyamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ vrīhiśabdena satuṣajātiviśeṣavācinā tanniyamātpiṣṭataṇḍulāvasthayornīvārādīnāṃ ca nivṛtiḥ|
analyzed: kapāleṣu śrapayati iti vacanāt na anyena śrapitam gṛhṇāti iti tad balena prakṛti upādānam prāpnoti iti na hi anyathā svayam śrapayitum śakyate evam prakṛti dravya upādāne prāpte kimavastham kiṃrūpam ca dravyam upādeyam iti ākāṅkṣāyām vrīhi śabdena sa tuṣa jāti viśeṣa vācinā tad niyamāt piṣṭa taṇḍula avasthayoḥ nīvāra ādīnām ca nivṛtiḥ

original: yadi tvanenaiva śāstreṇa prakṛtimupādāya havissaṃpādayetacca vrīhibhiriti vidhīyate tato gauravam| kapāleṣu śrapayatīti ca vidherānarthakyaṃ satyāṃ gatau syāt taccānyāyyaṃ tena yatra śrapaṇaṃ tatra tasya svayaṃ kartṛkatvaṃ yatra ca tatatra prakṛtyupādānaprāptiḥ yatra cāsau tatra vrīhiniyamaḥ|
analyzed: yadi tu anena eva śāstreṇa prakṛtim upādāya haviḥ saṃpādaya etat ca vrīhibhiḥ iti vidhīyate tatas gauravam kapāleṣu śrapayati iti ca vidheḥ ānarthakyam satyām gatau syāt tat ca anyāyyam tena yatra śrapaṇam tatra tasya svayam kartṛka tvam yatra ca prakṛti upādāna prāptiḥ yatra ca asau tatra vrīhi niyamaḥ
